## ConvertTo-DataTable


NAME
    ConvertTo-DataTable
    
SYNOPSIS
    Convert regular PowerShell objects to a DataTable object.
    
    
SYNTAX
    ConvertTo-DataTable [[-InputObject] <PSObject[]>] [[-DefaultType] <String>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Convert regular PowerShell objects to a DataTable object.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputObject <PSObject[]>
        The object to convert to a DataTable
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DefaultType <String>
        Override the default type.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                System.String
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>$myDataTable = $myObject | ConvertTo-DataTable
    
    # using the SqlServer PowerShell module to connect to SQL Server and query for and return data
    # returns data as an array of DataRow objects
    $drs=Invoke-Sqlcmd -ServerInstance "ServerName" -Database Databasename -Username UserName -Password Password -Query "SELECT * FROM [dbo].[DrawingValidation] where Owner='None' and UpToDate=1 order by stamptime desc"
    
    # use this function to Convert the DataRow array to a DataTable
    $dt=ConvertTo-DataTable $drs
    
    # use PWPS_DAB cmdlet to output the DataTable into a spreadsheet
    New-XLSXWorkbook -InputTables $dt -OutputFileName c:\temp\Output.xlsx
    
    
    
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Get-PWAuditTrailRecordsFromPreviousDays


NAME
    Get-PWAuditTrailRecordsFromPreviousDays
    
SYNOPSIS
    Returns audit trail records from previous days.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Get-PWAuditTrailRecordsFromPreviousDays [-DaysAgo] <Int32> [-IncludeIntermediateDays] [-AddDatasourceInformation] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Uses a SQL query to return audit trail records from previous days.
    

PARAMETERS
    -DaysAgo <Int32>
        Integer value to specify the desired number of days ago to return records for. A value of '1' is equal to yesterday.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeIntermediateDays [<SwitchParameter>]
        Switch to include records from intermediate results. If days ago is '5' and this switch is activated, audit trail records from 5 days ago up until now will be returned, as opposed to just the audit trail records from 5 days ago if this switch is not activated.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AddDatasourceInformation [<SwitchParameter>]
        Switch to add datasource information (DatasourceString =  'servername:datasourcename';DatasourceName = 'datasourcename'; ServerName = 'servername') to the returned DataTable. Useful when reporting against multiple servers and datasources.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return audit trail records from 10 days ago.
    
    Get-PWAuditTrailRecordsFromPreviousDays -DaysAgo 10 -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 2 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return audit trail records from 10 days ago, and add datasource information to the output DataTable.
    
    Get-PWAuditTrailRecordsFromPreviousDays -DaysAgo 10 -AddDatasourceInformation -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 3 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return audit trail records from the last 10 days up until this moment.
    
    Get-PWAuditTrailRecordsFromPreviousDays -DaysAgo 10 -IncludeIntermediateDays -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Get-PWPerformanceReportData


NAME
    Get-PWPerformanceReportData
    
SYNOPSIS
    Returns a dataset containing ProjectWise performance metrics.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Get-PWPerformanceReportData [-Connection <String>] [-Location <String>] [-ConnectingViaCache <String>] -Datasource <String> -ProjectWiseUserName <String> -ProjectWisePassword <SecureString> [-TestParentPath <String>] [-TestFileSizeInMB <Int32>] [-EnvironmentName <String>] 
    [-EnvironmentTableName <String>] [-EnvironmentColumnName <String>] [-IncludeWSGData] [-WSGServerURL <String>] [-OutputType <String>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Get-PWPerformanceReportData [-Connection <String>] [-Location <String>] [-ConnectingViaCache <String>] -Datasource <String> -UseBentleyIMS [-TestParentPath <String>] [-TestFileSizeInMB <Int32>] [-EnvironmentName <String>] [-EnvironmentTableName <String>] [-EnvironmentColumnName 
    <String>] [-IncludeWSGData] [-WSGServerURL <String>] [-OutputType <String>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Performs and times the execution of various tasks in ProjectWise, the results of which are output to a dataset containing four tables. All test documents/folders are cleaned up after the test has completed.
    

PARAMETERS
    -Connection <String>
        Used to specify the connection type for later sorting - e.g. "Home Wifi", "Bentley LAN", "4G Dongle" etc.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                Unknown
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Location <String>
        Used to specify the location from where the test is being run - e.g. "Melbourne, Victoria" etc.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                Unknown
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ConnectingViaCache <String>
        Used to specify whether or not the client is connecting via a caching server - accepts "True" or "False".
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Datasource <String>
        Used to specify the datasource to run the test - server:datasource.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ProjectWiseUserName <String>
        Used to specify the username for the ProjectWise account running the test.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ProjectWisePassword <SecureString>
        Used to specify the password for the ProjectWise account running the test.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -UseBentleyIMS [<SwitchParameter>]
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -TestParentPath <String>
        Used to specify a parent path under which all test operations will be completed. If not specified, test operations are completed at root level in the folder tree. All test documents/folders are cleaned up after the test has completed.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -TestFileSizeInMB <Int32>
        Used to specify the size of the files in MB used for testing, default value is 10MB.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                10
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EnvironmentName <String>
        Used to specify the name of the environment to create for testing - the environment will have a single attribute used for testing attribute updates. Default value is "PWPerfReport"
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                PWPerfReport
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EnvironmentTableName <String>
        Used to specify the table name for the test environment. Default value is "PWPerfReport"
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                PWPerfReport
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EnvironmentColumnName <String>
        Used to specify the column/attribure name for the test environment table. Default value is "Test_Attribute"
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                Test_Attribute
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeWSGData [<SwitchParameter>]
        Switch parameter used to activate the collection of WSG data. If activated, WSGServerURL must be specified.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WSGServerURL <String>
        Used to specify the WSG server URL when retrieving WSG data, e.g. "https://decide-pwce-aus-ws.bentley.com/ws"
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OutputType <String>
        Used to specify output data type as either PSObject or DataSet (erroneously called a datatable). Default value is PSObject
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                PSObject
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return a performance metric dataset for a home connection, not using a caching server, and output a PSObject.
    
    $PWPerformanceReportVariables = @{
            Connection = "Home Wifi";
            Location = "Melbourne, Victoria";
            ConnectingViaCache = "False"
            Datasource = "decide-pwce-aus.bentley.com:decide-pwce-aus-010"
            ProjectWiseUserName = "PWPerfReportUser"
            ProjectWisePassword = (Get-SecureStringFromEncryptedFile -FileName "C:\temp\ProjectWisePassword.txt")
            OutputType = PSObject
        }
        
        $PerformanceData = Get-PWPerformanceReportData @PWPerformanceReportVariables -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 2 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return a performance metric dataset for an office connection, using a caching server, and output a DataTable.
    
    $PWPerformanceReportVariables = @{
            Connection = "Bentley Office LAN";
            Location = "Melbourne, Victoria";
            ConnectingViaCache = "True"
            Datasource = "decide-pwce-aus.bentley.com:decide-pwce-aus-010"
            ProjectWiseUserName = "PWPerfReportUser"
            ProjectWisePassword = (Get-SecureStringFromEncryptedFile -FileName "C:\temp\ProjectWisePassword.txt")
            OutputType = DataTable
        }
        
        $PerformanceData = Get-PWPerformanceReportData @PWPerformanceReportVariables -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 3 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return a performance metric dataset for a home connection, not using a caching server, for a 1MB test file size, including WSG data, and output as a PSObject.
    
    $PWPerformanceReportVariables = @{
        Connection = "Home Wifi";
        Location = "Melbourne, Victoria";
        ConnectingViaCache = "False"
        Datasource = "decide-pwce-aus.bentley.com:decide-pwce-aus-010"
        ProjectWiseUserName = "PWPerfReportUser"
        ProjectWisePassword = (ConvertTo-SecureString -String PWPerfReportUser -AsPlainText -Force)
        OutputType = "PSObject"
        TestParentPath = "PWPerfReport"
        TestFileSizeInMB = 1
        WSGServerURL = "https://decide-pwce-aus-ws.bentley.com/ws"
    }
    $PerformanceData = Get-PWPerformanceReportDataTest @PWPerformanceReportVariables -IncludeWSGData -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Get-PWPSLogsFromPreviousDays


NAME
    Get-PWPSLogsFromPreviousDays
    
SYNOPSIS
    Returns log entries written by Write-PWPSLog from a specified number of days ago.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Get-PWPSLogsFromPreviousDays [[-LogFilePath] <String>] [-DaysAgo] <Int32> [-IncludeIntermediateDays] [[-Level] <String[]>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Searches a log file written using the Write-PWPSLog function, and returns entries from a specified number of days ago. Returns records from a single day only. There is no logging for this cmdlet by design.
    

PARAMETERS
    -LogFilePath <String>
        Target log file path to search. Default is 'C:\users\<username>\AppData\Local\Bentley\Logs\PowerShellLogging.log'.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                "$env:LOCALAPPDATA" + "\Bentley\Logs\PowerShellLogging.log"
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DaysAgo <Int32>
        Integer value to specify the desired number of days ago to return logs for. A value of '1' is equal to yesterday.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeIntermediateDays [<SwitchParameter>]
        Switch to include intermediate results. If days is '5' and this switch is activated, log entries from 5 days ago up until now will be returned, as opposed to just the log entries from 5 days ago if this switch is not activated.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Level <String[]>
        Target level to return. Default is set to return all levels. Takes multiple inputs. Acceptable input values are 'INFO','WARN' and 'ERROR'.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return all log entries from 10 days ago.
    
    Get-PowerShellLogsFromPreviousDays -DaysAgo 10 -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 2 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return all log entries from the last 10 days.
    
    Get-PowerShellLogsFromPreviousDays -DaysAgo 10 -IncludeIntermediateDays -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 3 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return info and warn log entries from 10 days ago.
    
    Get-PowerShellLogsFromPreviousDays -DaysAgo 10 -Level INFO,WARN -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 4 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will return error log entries from the last 10 days.
    
    Get-PowerShellLogsFromPreviousDays -DaysAgo 10 -IncludeIntermediateDays -Level ERROR -Verbose
    
    
    
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## New-PWEnumFolders


NAME
    New-PWEnumFolders
    
SYNOPSIS
    Runs the EnumFolders.exe with provided parameter values.
    
    
SYNTAX
    New-PWEnumFolders [-DataSourceName] <String> [[-UserName] <String>] [[-Password] <String>] [[-PWFolderID] <Int32>] [-RecurseFolders] [-IncludeDocuments] [-IncludeDeletedObjects] [-VerboseOperation] [-OutputFilePathName <String>] [-OpenOutputFile] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    The function runs the enumfolders.exe using the parameter values passed.
    

PARAMETERS
    -DataSourceName <String>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -UserName <String>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Password <String>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -PWFolderID <Int32>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RecurseFolders [<SwitchParameter>]
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeDocuments [<SwitchParameter>]
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeDeletedObjects [<SwitchParameter>]
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -VerboseOperation [<SwitchParameter>]
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OutputFilePathName <String>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                "c:\temp\"  + (Get-Date).Year + (Get-Date).Month + (Get-Date).Day + "_enumfolders.txt"
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OpenOutputFile [<SwitchParameter>]
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    None
    
    
OUTPUTS
    None
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>There are many options and configurations for this function. Use the following as a template to setup your reference scanning.
    
    $NewEnum = @{
    DataSourceName = '';
    UserName = '';
    Password = '';
    PWFolder = '';
    OutputFilePath = '';
    }
    New-PWEnumFolders @NewEnum -IncludeDocuments -RecurseFolders-OpenLogFile -Verbose

## New-PWScanForReferences


NAME
    New-PWScanForReferences
    
SYNOPSIS

    New-PWScanForReferences [-DataSourceName] <String> [[-UserName] <String>] [[-Password] <String>] [[-ScanMode] <String[]>] [-MasterDocuments <String[]>] [-MasterFolders <String[]>] [-RecurseMasterFolders] [-Priority <String[]>] [-RecursePriority] [-Proximity <String[]>] [-Order 
    <String>] [-Applications <String[]>] [-LogFilePath <String>] [-OpenLogFile] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    The function runs a scan for reference job using the parameter values passed. MUST be run in a 32Bit session of PowerShell.  See ScanRef documenation on the command line parameters for details on the cmdlet parameters functionality.
    

PARAMETERS
    -DataSourceName <String>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                references;linksets
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MasterDocuments <String[]>
        
        Required?                    false

        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RecurseMasterFolders [<SwitchParameter>]
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Priority <String[]>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RecursePriority [<SwitchParameter>]
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Proximity <String[]>
        [ValidateSet("0", "1", "r:1")]
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Order <String>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named

        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

INPUTS
    None
    
    
OUTPUTS
    None
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>There are many options and configurations for this function. Use the following as a template to setup your reference scanning.
    
    $NewScanRef = @{
    DataSourceName = '';
    UserName = '';
    Password = '';
    ScanMode = 'references';
    MasterDocuments = '';
    MasterFolders = '';
    Priority = '';
    Proximity = 'r:1';
    Order = 'priority;proximity';
    Applications = '';
    LogFilePath = '';
    }
    New-PWScanForReferences @NewScanRef -RecurseMasterFolders -RecursePriority -OpenLogFile -Verbose

## Write-PWPSLog


NAME
    Write-PWPSLog
    
SYNOPSIS
    Writes and appends logs to a log file.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Write-PWPSLog [-Message] <String> [[-Path] <String>] [[-Level] <String>] [-Cmdlet] <String> [-NoClobber] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Writes and appends logs to a log file. Format for each row is "DateTime [Level] Cmdlet - Message". Max file size for a single log is 10MB, and a maximum of four log files will be created. The older file will rollover if four files exist and the current file size exceeds the size 
    limit.
    

PARAMETERS
    -Message <String>
        Log message to write.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Path <String>
        Path to target log file. File will be created if it doesn't exist. Default path is "C:\users\<username>\AppData\Local\Bentley\Logs\PowerShellLogging.log".
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                "$env:LOCALAPPDATA" + "\Bentley\Logs\PowerShellLogging.log"
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Level <String>
        Severity level for the target log line. Accepts 'Error', 'Warn' and 'Info'.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                Info
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Cmdlet <String>
        Name of the cmdlet/function/script writing the log line. This is for sorting purposes when analysing logs, so source function/cmdlet/script can be easily identified.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    4
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NoClobber [<SwitchParameter>]
        Switch to enagle NoClobber. If enabled and the target log file already exists, the log will not be written and the file cannot be overwritten.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will write an info level log with function name Test-Logging to the default log location, with the message 'We are testing the logging'.
    
    Write-PWPSLog -Cmdlet 'Test-Logging' -Level Info -Message 'We are testing the logging'.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 2 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>This example will write an error level log with function name Test-Logging to C:\temp\log.log, with the message 'There was an error!'.
    
    Write-PWPSLog -Cmdlet 'Test-Logging' -Level Error -Message 'There was an error!'.

    New-PWLogin
    $oidcToken = Get-OIDCToken -authority https://ims.bentley.com
    $today = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"
    $projectName = $today + "_" + (Get-RandomString -Length 8 -Characters "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")
    $topLevel = "Projects\$today" 
    $rp = New-PWRichProject -NewFolderPath "$topLevel\$projectName" -ProjectType Civil -StorageArea Storage
    $CloudProjectId = Add-CloudProject -InputFolder $rp -CloudProjectName $projectName -CloudProjectNumber $projectName -OIDCToken $oidcToken -SetDriveSync -SetUserSync -SetAutoUserSync -WSGURL "https://mygateway.com/ws"

## Add-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnection


NAME
    Add-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnection
    
SYNOPSIS
    Add Work Area Connections to a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnection [-CloudProjectId] <string> [-OIDCToken] <OIDCAuthToken> [-ProjectsToConnect] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [-WSGURL] <string> [[-SetAsPrimary] <SwitchParameter>] [[-EnableDrive] <SwitchParameter>] [[-EnableUserSync] <SwitchParameter>] [[-SetAutoUserSync] 
    <SwitchParameter>] [[-MakeNameUnique] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -OIDCToken <OIDCAuthToken>
        Pass OIDC Token returned from Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CloudProjectId <string>
        Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project ID.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ProjectsToConnect <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Array of rich projects to connect to Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WSGURL <string>
        WSG URL is required.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SetAsPrimary <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EnableDrive <SwitchParameter>
        Makes the created WAC the primary connection. If there is an existing WAC, it will be unset.
        
        Enable ProjectWise Drive. Only valid for primary connections.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EnableUserSync <SwitchParameter>
        Enable User Sync.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SetAutoUserSync <SwitchParameter>
        Make the Work Area Connection name unique (otherwise uses name of rich project).
        
        Set this WAC to be Automatic User Sync. Will cause the previous auto user sync connection to be unset.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    7
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MakeNameUnique <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    8
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    System.Collections.Generic.List`1[[PWPS_DAB.ConnectedProjectAdapter+WorkAreaConnectionNew, PWPS_DAB, Version=24.0.2.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]]
    
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    # Get an OIDC Token
    $oidcToken = Get-OIDCToken -authority https://ims.bentley.com
    # Create a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project
    $today = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd" 
    $projectName = $today + "_" + (Get-RandomString -Length 8 -Characters "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")
    $CloudProjectId = Add-CloudProject -CloudProjectName $projectName -CloudProjectNumber $projectName -OIDCToken $oidcToken
    # Create a work area
    $topLevel = "Projects\$today" 
    New-PWLogin ServerName:MyDatasourceWithAGateway -BentleyIMS 
    $rp = New-PWRichProject -NewFolderPath "$topLevel\$projectName" -ProjectType Civil -StorageArea Storage  
    # Create the work area connection
    $wac = Add-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnection $CloudProjectId -ProjectsToConnect $rp -WSGURL MyWSGUrl -OIDCToken $oidcToken -EnableUserSync 
    # set work area as a connected project to the Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project
    # Open and see what we've done 
    Open-CloudProject $CloudProjectId

## Add-PDFQRCode


NAME
    Add-PDFQRCode
    
SYNOPSIS
    Apply arbitrary QR Code to PDF from File System.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PDFQRCode [-FileName] <string> [-URL] <string> [[-StampInForeground] <SwitchParameter>] [[-X] <int>] [[-Y] <int>] [[-Size] <int>] [[-NativeUnits] <SwitchParameter>] [[-CropBorder] <int>] [[-RemoveImages] <SwitchParameter>] [[-OverWriteFile] <SwitchParameter>] [[-DoNotShortenURL] 
    <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -FileName <string>
        Documents to copy out and print (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -URL <string>
        Provide this value instead to produce a generic code.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -X <int>
        X coordinate of lower left corner of code image.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                50
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Y <int>
        Y coordinate of lower left corner of code image.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                50
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Size <int>
        Size of image. Works best in multiples of 33 due to the way QR Code image is generated.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                99
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NativeUnits <SwitchParameter>
        (Obsolete, not used). Units are in PDF Units. Set this if your QR Code is not showing up.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CropBorder <int>
        (Obsolete, not used). Number of units to crop around the edge of the QR Code (can have a lot of white border based on the size of the image). Use with NativeUnits switch.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RemoveImages <SwitchParameter>
        Remove the existing images.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    7
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OverWriteFile <SwitchParameter>
        Will generate copy of the file if not set.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    8
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DoNotShortenURL <SwitchParameter>
        Won't attempt to shorten URL.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    9
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -StampInForeground <SwitchParameter>
        Stamp in Foreground.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    10
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    System.String
        Documents to copy out and print (Required).
    
    System.String
        Provide this value instead to produce a generic code.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #URL can be any valid URL.
    Add-PDFQRCode c:\PDFs\PDF1.pdf -URL www.bentley.com -X 100 -Y 100 -Size 100
    #Try NativeUnits flag if QR Code is too small or invisible. Use -RemoveImages to remove QR Code from previously stamped PDF.
    Add-PDFQRCode c:\PDFs\PDF1.pdf -URL www.bentley.com -X 100 -Y 100 -Size 100 -NativeUnits -RemoveImages

    "https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws"
    $rp.Locate()
    Open-PW365Project $pw365id

## Add-PW365WorkAreaConnectionOIDC


NAME
    Add-PW365WorkAreaConnectionOIDC
    
SYNOPSIS
    Add Work Area Connections to a PW365 project. Token requires https://imsoidc.bentley.com authority.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PW365WorkAreaConnectionOIDC [-OIDCToken] <OIDCAuthToken> [-PW365ProjectId] <string> [-ProjectsToConnect] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [-WSGURL] <string> [[-WSGVersion] <string>] [[-EnableDrive] <SwitchParameter>] [[-EnableUserSync] <SwitchParameter>] [[-MakeNameUnique] 
    <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -OIDCToken <OIDCAuthToken>
        Pass access_token part of OIDC Token returned from Get-OIDCToken cmdlet. Authority https://imsoidc.bentley.com. Required.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -PW365ProjectId <string>
        Connected/PW365 Project Id.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ProjectsToConnect <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Array of rich projects to add to PW365 project as .
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WSGURL <string>
        WSG URL is required
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WSGVersion <string>
        Defaults to v2.8.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                v2.8
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EnableDrive <SwitchParameter>
        Enable ProjectWise Drive.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EnableUserSync <SwitchParameter>
        Enable User Sync.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MakeNameUnique <SwitchParameter>
        Make the Work Area Connection name unique (otherwise uses name of rich project).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    7
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    New-PWLogin decide-pwce-us.bentley.com:decide-pwce-us-10 -BentleyIMS 
    # need token from this authority for some things 
    $oidcToken = Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com -ClientID powershelltokengen 
    # need token from this authority for other things 
    $oidcToken2 = Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://imsoidc.bentley.com -ClientID powershelltokengen2 
    $t = Get-PW365Templates $oidcToken 
    $today = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd" 
    $topLevel = "PW365 Projects\$today B" 
    # create 5 projects to demo multiple work area support 
    for ($i = 1; $i -lt 6; $i++) 
    { 
        $projectName = $today + "_" + (Get-RandomString -Length 8 -Characters "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ") 
        $rp = New-PWRichProject -NewFolderPath "$topLevel\$projectName" -TemplateName Civil -StorageArea Storage -FolderDepthToCopy 1 
    } 
    $pw365ida = Add-PW365Project -PW365ProjectName $projectName -PW365ProjectNumber $projectName -OIDCToken $oidcToken -PW365TemplateName $t[0].displayName 
    # default WAC does not get created immediately 
    $wacs = Get-PWWorkAreaConnectionsOIDC -ConnectedProjectIds $pw365ida -OIDCToken $oidcToken2 
    while ($wacs -eq $null) 
    { 
        Write-Verbose "Waiting for WACs..." 
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 10 
        $wacs = Get-PWWorkAreaConnectionsOIDC -ConnectedProjectIds $pw365ida -OIDCToken $oidcToken2 
    } 
    if ($wacs - ne $null) 
    { 
        # should just be one and we want to disable it to reduce confusion and allow regular work area to be synced to Drive 
        Set-PWWorkAreaConnectionDisabledOIDC $pw365ida -WorkAreaConnectionId $wacs.id -OIDCToken $oidcToken2 
        # adding this work area and setting user sync and drive sync 
        $wacs2 = Add-PW365WorkAreaConnectionOIDC $pw365ida -ProjectsToConnect $rp -WSGURL "https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws" -OIDCToken $oidcToken2 -EnableDrive -EnableUserSync 
    } 
    # get all the projects in a folder 
    $rps = Get-PWRichProjects $topLevel 
    $wacs3 = Add-PW365WorkAreaConnectionOIDC $pw365ida -ProjectsToConnect $rps -WSGURL "https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws" -OIDCToken $oidcToken2 -EnableUserSync 
    # set these as Connected Projects to the PW365 project 
    foreach ($rpa in $rps) 
    { 
        Set-PWConnectedProjectAssociation $rpa -ConnectedProjectGUID $pw365ida 
    } 
    # open and see what we've done 
    Open-PW365Project $pw365ida
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Add-PWApplicationAction


NAME
    Add-PWApplicationAction
    
SYNOPSIS
    Adds an application action.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PWApplicationAction [[-InputUsers] <User[]>] [-Application] <string> [-ActionType] <string> [-Program] <string> [-Arguments <string>] [-ClassName <string>] [-EnableLagacyIntegration <SwitchParameter>] [-Global <SwitchParameter>] [-PathName <string>]

        simultaneously.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named

    Adds users to a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project using an OIDC token.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PWCloudProjectUsersOIDC [[-InputUsers] <User[]>] [[-FolderPath] <string>] [-OIDCToken] <OIDCAuthToken> [-Roles] <string[]> [[-CloudProjectId] <string>] [[-Emails] <string[]>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Adds users to a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project. These users can be an array of user objects from the pipeline or a comma separated list of emails passed in with the Email parameter. The project itself can be specified by providing a work area path that has an associated 
    Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project or the GUID id.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputUsers <User[]>
        Array of ProjectWise User objects from the pipeline.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderPath <string>
        Path to the rich project from which we'll find the associated Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OIDCToken <OIDCAuthToken>
        Token from Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Roles <string[]>
        Array of roles (e.g. Engineer,"Custom Project Role 1").
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CloudProjectId <string>
        Pass Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project Guid string.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Emails <string[]>
        Array of user emails (e.g. "user.one@companytwo.com","user.two@companythree.com").
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    Bentley.ProjectWise.PowerShell.Common.User[]
        Array of ProjectWise User objects from the pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Will add users with email specifications passed to Get-PWUsersByMatch.  The users will be added with the roles of
    #"Engineer" and  "Custom User Role 1".  The users will be added to the project associated with the work area  
    #identified by a supplied path:
    # 
    # Get required authentication token
    $OIDCToken = Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
    # Add the users
    Get-PWUsersByMatch -UserName 'sam.jones','john.smith', *.williams' | Add-PWCloudProjectUsersOIDC -OIDCToken $OIDCToken -Roles "Engineer", "Custom User Role 1" -FolderPath "PWPS_DAB Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project Test\Projects 2\Project A"
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    #Will create a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project and add users identified by their emails to it.  The roles are also specified: 
    # Get required OIDC token
    $OIDCToken = Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
    # Create the Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project
    $CloudProjectId = Add-CloudProject -CloudProjectName "My Cloud Project"  -CloudProjectNumber "PN12345" -MakeUnique -OIDCToken $oidcToken
    # Add the users
    Add-PWCloudProjectUsersOIDC -CloudProjectId $CloudProjectId -OIDCToken $OIDCTOken -Emails "fred.jones@acme.com","sam.smith@acme.com" -Roles "Engineer", "Custom User Role 1"

        Required?                    true

        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -InputDocument <ProjectWiseDocument>
        Document object to add to the flat set. Only accepts one document object at a time.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SetMemberName <string>
        Name of the document to be added to the flat set file.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SetMemberPath <string>
        Folder path of the member to be added to the flat set file.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CheckOut <SwitchParameter>
        When the CheckOut switch parameter is included, the member document will be set to checkout when set is open.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -LockToVersion <SwitchParameter>
        When the LockToVersion switch parameter is included, the Lock To Version option for the member will be toggled on.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216).

        Document object to add to the flat set. Only accepts one document object at a time.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Example usage Add-PWDocumentFlatSetMember.
    The following will add a new member to a flat set and set it to check out..
    Add-PWDocumentFlatSetMember -FolderPath 'Projects' -SetName 'DGNs' -SetMemberName 'NewDrawing.dgn' -SetMemberPath 'Project\Drawings' -CheckOut -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    #Example usage Add-PWDocumentFlatSetMember.
    The following will add a new member to a flat set by passing a document object and toggle on Lock To Verion.
    
    $docs = Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath 'Project\Drawings' -DocumentName 'NewDrawing.dgn'
    $docs | Add-PWDocumentFlatSetMember -FolderPath 'Projects' -SetName 'DGNs' -LockToVersion -Verbose

## Add-PWDocumentLogicalSet


NAME
    Add-PWDocumentLogicalSet
    
SYNOPSIS
    Createa a logical set from a master document and an array of references.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PWDocumentLogicalSet [-Master] <ProjectWiseDocument> [-References] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [[-CheckOut] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Createa a logical set from a master document and an array of references. Masters cannot be DGNs or DWGs so as not to interfere with the integration-made references.
    

PARAMETERS

        Master document.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CheckOut <SwitchParameter>
        If set, will build a check out relationship rather than a copy out.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216).

    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument
        Master document.

## Add-PWDocumentsWithCode


NAME
    Add-PWDocumentsWithCode
    
SYNOPSIS
    Create new abstract documents with document codes.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PWDocumentsWithCode [-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [-Attributes] <Hashtable> [[-NumberOfDocuments] <int>] [[-StartNumber] <int>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Will will create abstract documents using the document code.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Array of folders to process. Should use Get-PWFolders or related cmdlet to generate
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Attributes <Hashtable>
        Hashtable of attributes. Hashtable in PowerShell looks like this @{Name = 'Value'; Name2 = 'Value2' }
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NumberOfDocuments <int>
        Number of documents to create (Required).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -StartNumber <int>
        Start number for naming (Optional).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                -1
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Array of folders to process. Should use Get-PWFolders or related cmdlet to generate
    
    System.Collections.Hashtable
        Hashtable of attributes. Hashtable in PowerShell looks like this @{Name = 'Value'; Name2 = 'Value2' }
    
    
OUTPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
    
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    # Create 5 abstract documents using document code populated with the passed default attribute values
    Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Replicated\Project 01' | Add-PWDocumentsWithCode -Attributes @{ ProjectNumber = 'BSI400'; AreaShort = 'RW'; DocumentTypeShort = '2DM'; LevelShort = 'NA' } -NumberOfDocuments 5
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    # Create an abstract document using document code populated with the passed default attribute values and then attach a dummy file to each with the appropriate name
    Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Replicated\Project 01' | Add-PWDocumentsWithCode -Attributes @{ ProjectNumber = 'BSI400'; AreaShort = 'RW'; DocumentTypeShort = '2DM'; LevelShort = 'NA' }  | Update-PWDocumentFile -NewFilePathName 'C:\temp\dummy.txt'

        Position?                    0

        Accept pipeline input?       false

    -ColumnName <string>

        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ColumnWidth <string>
        Width of column to be added to environment.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value

## Add-PWPDFLink


NAME
    Add-PWPDFLink
    
SYNOPSIS
    Apply a link to a PDF in ProjectWise. (Marty suggested this months ago and I'm just getting around to it).
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PWPDFLink [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [[-WSGURL] <string>] [[-LinkText] <string>] [[-URL] <string>] [[-X] <int>] [[-Y] <int>] [[-Width] <int>] [[-Height] <int>] [[-TextSize] <double>] [[-NativeUnits] <SwitchParameter>] [[-FriendlyLinkPrefix] <string>] 
    [[-MakeFriendlyProjectWiseLink] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Documents to copy out and print (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WSGURL <string>
        If provided, will affix a QR code which will resolve to this same document via your WSG web server.
        
        Example value like: "https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws/v2.5/Repositories/Bentley.PW--decide-pwce-us.bentley.com~3Adecide-pwce-us-10/"
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -URL <string>
        Provide this value instead to produce a generic code.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -X <int>
        X coordinate of lower left corner of code image.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                50
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Y <int>
        Y coordinate of lower left corner of code image.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                50
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Width <int>
        Width of the link.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                100
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Height <int>
        Height of the link.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                25
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -TextSize <double>
        Text size for link text. (Defaults to 10).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    7
        Default value                10
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NativeUnits <SwitchParameter>
        Units are in PDF Units. This will vary depending on how the PDF is created. Try changing if your link does not show up where expected
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    8
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MakeFriendlyProjectWiseLink <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    9
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FriendlyLinkPrefix <string>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    9
        Default value                https://projectwiseconnector.azurewebsites.net/api/GetProcessGmailLink?code=zBBTVzTLoCXyxzYs/eme6FmqAnOnQBRHQHnNHl55aNpOS59HfWapQA==&timeout=3000&pwlink=
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -LinkText <string>
        Link text to use. If not set, will use document name.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    10
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>

        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Documents to copy out and print (Required).
    
    
OUTPUTS

## Add-PWPicklist


NAME
    Add-PWPicklist
    
SYNOPSIS
    Add-PWPicklist adds new custom picklist within the current datasource.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PWPicklist [-PicklistName] <string> [-PicklistValues] <string[]> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Adds new custom picklist within the current datasource. Once a custom picklist is created, it can be added to an environment attribute. Within ProjectWise Administrator, enter the following into the attribute value tab: SELECT PicklistValue FROM CustomPicklists WHERE 
    PicklistName='MyPicklist' Be sure to replace the picklistname with a valid name.
    

PARAMETERS
    -PicklistName <string>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -PicklistValues <string[]>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

## Add-PWUsersToCloudProject


NAME
    Add-PWUsersToCloudProject
    
SYNOPSIS
    Adds users to a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PWUsersToCloudProject [[-InputUsers] <User[]>] [[-FolderPath] <string>] [-Token] <string> [-Roles] <string[]> [[-CloudProjectId] <string>] [[-Emails] <string[]>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Adds users to a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project. These users can be an array of user objects from the pipeline or a comma separated list of emails passed in with the Email parameter. The project itself can be specified by providing a work area path that has an associated 
    Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project or the GUID id.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputUsers <User[]>
        Array of ProjectWise User objects from the pipeline.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderPath <string>
        Path to the rich project from which we'll find the associated Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Token <string>
        Authentication token required by cmdlet. Obtain by using Get-PWConnectionClientToken
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    6
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Roles <string[]>
        Array of roles (e.g. Engineer,"Custom Project Role 1").
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    7
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CloudProjectId <string>
        Pass Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project Guid string.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    8
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Emails <string[]>
        Array of user emails (e.g. "user.one@companytwo.com","user.two@companythree.com").
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    9
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    Bentley.ProjectWise.PowerShell.Common.User[]
        Array of ProjectWise User objects from the pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Will add the users with email from user list "UsersToAddToProjectA" with the roles of "Engineer" and  "Custom User Role 1" 
    #to the Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project associated with the WorkArea identified by a supplied path:
    # Get required authentication token
    $CCToken = Get-PWConnectionClientToken
    Get-PWUsersInUserList -UserList "UsersToAddToProject" | Add-PWUsersToCloudProject -Token $CCToken -Roles "Engineer", "Custom User Role 1" -FolderPath "PWPS_DAB Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project Test\Projects 2\Project A"
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    #Will create a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project and add users identified by their emails to it.  The roles are also specified: 
    # Get token required for Add-CloudProject
    $OIDCToken = Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
    $CloudProjectId = Add-CloudProject -CloudProjectName "My Cloud Project"  -CloudProjectNumber "PN12345" -MakeUnique -OIDCToken $oidcToken
    # Get token required for Add-PWUsersToCloudProject
    $CCToken = Get-PWConnectionClientToken
    Add-PWUsersToCloudProject -CloudProjectId $CloudProjectId -Token $CCToken -Emails "fred.jones@acme.com","sam.smith@acme.com" -Roles "Engineer", "Custom User Role 1"
    
    
RELATED LINKS

    Add-PWUsersToCloudProjectByGroup -FolderPath "PWPS_DAB Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project Test\Projects 2\Project A" -Groups "Project Managers" -Roles Manage

## Add-PWUsersToCloudProjectByGroupOIDC


NAME
    Add-PWUsersToCloudProjectByGroupOIDC
    
SYNOPSIS
    Takes group name(s) and associates users in the group(s) with a Bentley Infrastructure project. Uses an OIDC token.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Add-PWUsersToCloudProjectByGroupOIDC [[-FolderPath] <string>] [[-FolderId] <int>] [-Groups] <string[]> [-OIDCToken] <OIDCAuthToken> [-Roles] <string[]> [[-CloudProjectId] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Takes group name(s) and associates users in the group(s) with a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project. The Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project may be identified by its GUID ID or a ProjectWise folder path, or a ProjectWise folder ID. Only users with email addresses specified will be 
    added to the Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
    

PARAMETERS
    -FolderPath <string>
        Path to the workarea from which we'll find the associated Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderId <int>
        Id of workarea from which we'll find the associated Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Groups <string[]>
        Group name containing participants to add to the Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OIDCToken <OIDCAuthToken>
        Token from Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Roles <string[]>
        Array of roles.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    4
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CloudProjectId <string>
        Pass Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project Guid string if you have it instead of folders.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see

INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS

    # Example usage for adding users by group to a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project.
    # Will add the users with email in the Project Mangers group to the Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project associated with work area
    # Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project Projects\Parkland Division
    $OIDCToken = Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
    Add-PWUsersToCloudProjectByGroupOIDC -OIDCToken $OIDCToken -FolderPath "PWPS_DAB Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project Test\Projects 2\Project A" -Groups "Project Managers" -Role Manage
