## New-PWDocumentVersion


NAME
    New-PWDocumentVersion
    
SYNOPSIS
    Creates new versions of ProjectWise documents passed on the pipeline.
    
    
SYNTAX
    New-PWDocumentVersion [-InputDocument] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [[-VersionString] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    #Search for documents and version them to version A.
    
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -SearchName "Documents in Released State" | New-PWDocumentVersion -VersionString A
    
    #Search for documents in folder and version to next version.
    
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Project A\Files to Version" | New-PWDocumentVersion
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocument <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        List of documents from pipeline (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -VersionString <string>
        Optional version string.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        List of documents from pipeline (Required).
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Search for documents and version them to version A.
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -SearchName "Documents in Released State" | New-PWDocumentVersion -VersionString A
    #Search for documents in folder version to next version.
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Project A\Files to Version" | New-PWDocumentVersion

## New-PWDocumentViaWSG


NAME
    New-PWDocumentViaWSG
    
SYNOPSIS
    Use ProjectWise Connector to upload a file via WSG. Might be useful when ProjectWise client is not installed or port 5800 connection is not available.
    
    
SYNTAX
    New-PWDocumentViaWSG [-Token] <string> [-WSGURL] <string> [-Datasource] <string> [-Folder] <string> [-SourceURL] <string> [[-FileName] <string>] [[-Title] <string>] [[-Email] <string>] [[-SuppressMakeUnique] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -Token <string>
        Token (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WSGURL <string>
        WSG URL (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Datasource <string>
        Datasource Name (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Folder <string>
        Target Folder Path (Required). Will be created if necessary.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SourceURL <string>
        URL of file to upload (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    4
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FileName <string>
        File name (Optional). Provide if you know it particularly if URL is encoded.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Title <string>
        Document description (Optional).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Email <string>
        Provide email to get an email with a link to download the file from ProjectWise (Optional).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    7
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SuppressMakeUnique <SwitchParameter>
        Web service appends a suffix to the filename/document name by default to ensure uniqueness (Optional).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    8
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    System.String
        Token (Required).
    
    System.String
        WSG URL (Required).
    
    System.String
        Datasource Name (Required).
    
    System.String
        Target Folder Path (Required). Will be created if necessary.
    
    System.String
        URL of file to upload (Required).
    
    System.String
        File name (Optional). Provide if you know it particularly if URL is encoded.
    
    System.String
        Document description (Optional).
    
    System.String
        Provide email to get an email with a link to download the file from ProjectWise (Optional).
    
    System.Management.Automation.SwitchParameter
        Web service appends a suffix to the filename/document name by default to ensure uniqueness (Optional).
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    $encrytedPassword = Read-Host -Prompt "Enter Password:" -AsSecureString
    $token = Get-PWConnectorToken -UserName "user.name" -Password $encryptedPassword
    $params = @{
    Token=$token
    WSGURL="https://server-ws.bentley.com/ws/"
    Datasource="decide-pwce-us.bentley.com:decide-pwce-us-10"
    Folder="PowerShell Connector\Cmdlet"
    Email="user.name@email.com"
    SourceURL="https://1drv.ms/u/s!ArLe7rEb_guVgpRjGIN_5DcJkLhD2Q"
    Title="Upload from One Drive via PowerShell"
    Filename="test20180209a.zip"
    SuppressMakeUnique=$true
    }
    New-PWDocumentViaWSG @params
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    #Equivalent to first example, but uses Invoke-RestMethod instead of New-PWDocumentViaWSG
    $encrytedPassword = Read-Host -Prompt "Enter Password:" -AsSecureString
    $token = Get-PWConnectorToken -UserName "user.name" -Password $encryptedPassword
    $uploadBody = ConverTo-Json @{
    Token=$token
    WSGURL="https://server-ws.bentley.com/ws/"
    Datasource="decide-pwce-us.bentley.com:decide-pwce-us-10"
    Folder="PowerShell Connector\REST Upload"
    Email="user.name@email.com"
    SourceURL="https://1drv.ms/u/s!ArLe7rEb_guVgpRjGIN_5DcJkLhD2Q"
    Title="Upload from One Drive via PowerShell and REST"
    Filename="test20180209b.zip"
    MakeUnique=$false
    }
    $urlForUpload="https://projectwiseconnector.azurewebsites.net/api/PostFileToDatasource?code=24g5wGbJOf/k5bCla0ddjOpu06SNApVpvvMOl60tfQ0bbrDoxnGwPA=="
    Invoke-RestMethod -ContentType "Application/Json" -Method Post -Body $uploadBody -Uri $urlForUpload

DESCRIPTION
    Create a new ProjectWise Group. Returns a ProjectWise Group Object.
    

PARAMETERS
    -GroupName <string>
        Name of group to be created.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -GroupDescription <string>
        Description of group to be created.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Domain <string>
        Provide domain to add a Windows group.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MembershipIsUpdatedBySTS <SwitchParameter>
        Update Membership By IMS Claims.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS

    New-PWGroupByName -GroupName 'NewGroup' -Group Description 'New ProjectWise Group' -MembershipIsUpdatedByIMS -Verbose

## New-PWInputOutputPerformanceReport


NAME
    New-PWInputOutputPerformanceReport
    
SYNOPSIS
    Keep track of performance statistics for datasource.
    
    
SYNTAX
    New-PWInputOutputPerformanceReport [[-OutputFileName] <string>] [[-OptOutOfCentralReporting] <SwitchParameter>] [[-NoCleanup] <SwitchParameter>] [[-ThrowErrorOnCreateFailure] <SwitchParameter>] [[-FileSizeK] <int>] [[-CleanUpAuditTrail] <SwitchParameter>] 
    [[-CollectExpensiveStatistics] <SwitchParameter>] [[-OutputFolder] <string>] [[-Storages] <string[]>] [[-NumberOfFiles] <int>] [-CustomerName] <string> [[-CustomerInfo] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Intent is to keep an on-going log of performance. Reports on performance of individual storage areas, and saves list of currently connected users.
    

PARAMETERS
    -OutputFileName <string>
        Output file name. If no XLSX extension, will save in SQLite format. If not provided, will output as data table suitable for insert to SQL Server
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FileSizeK <int>
        Size for test file to use for file transfer tests
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CleanUpAuditTrail <SwitchParameter>
        If set, will remove audit trail entries for the currently connected user (prevents extraneous entries for admin connections)
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CollectExpensiveStatistics <SwitchParameter>
        If set, will collect statistics, which can take a while.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OutputFolder <string>
        Use this folder to write sqlite output.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Storages <string[]>
        Provide a list of storage areas to test. Tests all storage areas by default.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NumberOfFiles <int>
        Number of files to use in test. Defaults to 5.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    7
        Default value                5
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CustomerName <string>
        Required for central reporting purposes. Users will be able to extract reports based on this value. Use something unique and descriptive. ("My company, Hosted datasources, Melbourne office")
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    8
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CustomerInfo <string>
        Optional extra information to collect about test instance (customer address, project name, etc.)
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    9
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OptOutOfCentralReporting <SwitchParameter>
        Set this to opt out of central data collection
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    10
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NoCleanup <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    11
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ThrowErrorOnCreateFailure <SwitchParameter>

        Required?                    false
        Position?                    12
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Will save report to a local SQLite database, clean up the audit trial entries for this user and collect some statistics which can take time.
    New-PWInputOutputPerformanceReport -OutputFileName c:\report\stats.db -FileSizeK 100 -CleanUpAuditTrail -CollectExpensiveStatistics -CustomerName "My Company, Melbourne"
    #SQLiteStudio seems like an adequate managment tool (http://sqlitestudio.pl/?act=download).
    #Will save report to a local XLSX file (will append if file exists), clean up the audit trial entries for this user and collect some statistics which can take time.
    New-PWInputOutputPerformanceReport -OutputFileName c:\report\stats.xlsx -FileSizeK 100 -NumberOfFiles 10 -CleanUpAuditTrail -CollectExpensiveStatistics -CustomerName "My Company, Melbourne"

## New-PWRichProjectFromTemplate


NAME
    New-PWRichProjectFromTemplate
    
SYNOPSIS
    Creates a new rich project / work area from a template project.

    New-PWRichProjectFromTemplate [-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder> [-NewProjectName] <string> [-TemplateName] <string> [-StorageArea] <string> [-DoNotCopyDocuments <SwitchParameter>] [-NewProjectDescription <string>] [-UpdateAllStorageAreas <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    New-PWRichProjectFromTemplate [-NewFolderPathName] <string> [-NewProjectName] <string> [-TemplateName] <string> [-StorageArea] <string> [-DoNotCopyDocuments <SwitchParameter>] [-NewProjectDescription <string>] [-UpdateAllStorageAreas <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Accepts a folder object from the pipeline or a project path including the new project name.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder>
        Folder object from pipeline to create new Rich Project / Work Area in. Requires the new project name to be included in the NewProjectName parameter.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewProjectName <string>
        Name of new Rich Project / Work Area.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewFolderPathName <string>
        Full folder path and name of new Rich Project / Work Area to create. Error if already exists.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewProjectDescription <string>
        Project description for new Rich Project / Work Area.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -TemplateName <string>
        Name of Template project to be used for new Rich Project / Work Area.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -StorageArea <string>
        Storage area name to be used when creating new Rich Project / Work Area. Required. Error if not found. Only the project folder will use this storage area unless the UpdateAllStorageAreas switch parameter is included.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -UpdateAllStorageAreas <SwitchParameter>
        When included, will use the provided storage area for ALL folders in the new Rich Project / Work Area.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DoNotCopyDocuments <SwitchParameter>
        Will copy documents from the template by default. Set this switch to prevent.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder
        Folder object from pipeline to create new Rich Project / Work Area in. Requires the new project name to be included in the NewProjectName parameter.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder
    
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Example usage for creating a new project from a folder object with the option to NOT copy documents. Returns a folder object for the new project created.
    New-PWRichProjectFromTemplate -InputFolder (Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'PowerShell' -NewProjectName 'MyNewProject' -TemplateName "Civil Template"  -StorageArea 'Storage_01' -DoNotCopyDocuments -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    Example usage for creating a new project from a folder path and name. Also, includes an optional description, and the option to update the storage area for all sub-folders. Returns a folder object for the new project created.
    New-PWRichProject -NewFolderPathName "PowerShell\MyNewProject" -NewProjectDescription 'My New Project' -TemplateName "Civil Template"  -StorageArea 'Storage_01' -UpdateAllStorageAreas -Verbose

    New-XLSXWorkbook
    
SYNOPSIS
    Write an array of generic DataTables to an XLSX Workbook.
    
    
SYNTAX
    New-XLSXWorkbook [-InputTables] <DataTable[]> [-OutputFileName] <string> [[-Open] <SwitchParameter>] [[-PreserveLinksInExistingWorkbook] <SwitchParameter>] [[-DateFormat] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputTables <DataTable[]>
        Array of System.Data.DataTable from the pipeline (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OutputFileName <string>
        Output file name.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Open <SwitchParameter>
        Open created workbook in Excel.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -PreserveLinksInExistingWorkbook <SwitchParameter>
        Preserve the ProjectWise links in an existing workbook. Has big performance implications for adding to existing workbooks.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DateFormat <string>
        Date format.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                h:mm AM/PM
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    System.Data.DataTable[]
        Array of System.Data.DataTable from the pipeline (Required).
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Get a report of documents in the given folder tree and output to XLSX directly
    Get-PWDocumentReportDataTable -ProjectWiseFolder "PWPS\Projects 2\Project A" -Recurse -IncludeAuditTrail | New-XLSXWorkbook -OutputFileName c:\temp\tables.xlsx
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Open-SynchroProject


NAME
    Open-SynchroProject
    
SYNOPSIS
    Open Synchro Project.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Open-SynchroProject [-SynchroProjectId] <string> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -SynchroProjectId <string>
        Connected Project Id.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    $oidcToken = Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com -ClientID powershelltokengen
    $templatessynchro = Get-PW365Templates $oidcToken -OrganizationTemplates -ProjectType SYNCHRO
    $today = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"
    $projectName = $today + "_" + (Get-RandomString -Length 8 -Characters "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")
    $synchroproject = Add-SynchroProject -PW365ProjectName $projectName -PW365ProjectNumber $projectName -OIDCToken $oidcToken -PW365TemplateName $templatessynchro[0].displayName -SetAsPrimary -SetDriveSync -SetUserSync -SetAutoUserSync -WSGURL "https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws" 
    -BillingCountry Canada -UseOrganizationTemplates
    Open-SynchroProject $synchroproject

## Purge-PWDocumentLocalCopy


NAME
    Purge-PWDocumentLocalCopy
    
SYNOPSIS
    Purge-PWDocumentLocalCopy removes the local working directory copy of the specified document(s).
    
    
SYNTAX
    Purge-PWDocumentLocalCopy [-InputDocument] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [[-UserName] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Purge-PWDocumentLocalCopy removes the local working directory copy of the specified document(s). Documents can be passed via the pipeline.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocument <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Input array of ProjectWiseDocument objects from the pipeline (Required). Use Get-PWDocumentBySearch to feed pipeline.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -UserName <string>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Input array of ProjectWiseDocument objects from the pipeline (Required). Use Get-PWDocumentBySearch to feed pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    The following will purge the local documents passed via the pipeline for the current user.
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Projects\Test" | Purge-PWDocumentLocalCopy -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    The following will purge the local documents passed via the pipeline for the provided user.
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Projects\Test" | Purge-PWDocumentLocalCopy -UserName 'powershellUser' -Verbose
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Read-PWPDFQRCode


NAME
    Read-PWPDFQRCode
    
SYNOPSIS
    (This has been deprecated and disabled to eliminate some licensing issues. We detected no usage of this cmdlet in 2021. Let us know if this functionality is still required.) Read QR Code from a PDF in ProjectWise. Returns array of strings from the value on each page in PDF.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Read-PWPDFQRCode [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [[-X] <int>] [[-Y] <int>] [[-Size] <int>] [[-IsBarCode] <SwitchParameter>] [[-SaveCroppedImages] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Documents to copy out and print (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -X <int>
        X coordinate of lower left corner of code image. (0, 0 is top left of page)
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                50
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Y <int>
        Y coordinate of lower left corner of code image. (0, 0 is top left of page)
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                50
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Size <int>
        Size of image.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                100
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IsBarCode <SwitchParameter>
        Set if expecting barcode instead of QR Code.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SaveCroppedImages <SwitchParameter>
        Save cropped images (for debugging X, Y and Size).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Documents to copy out and print (Required).
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #0,0 is top left of page.
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub-Folder' -FileName %.pdf | Read-PWPDFQRCode -X 100 -Y 100 -Size 100

## Remove-CloudProject


NAME
    Remove-CloudProject
    
SYNOPSIS
    Remove Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Remove-CloudProject [[-InputFolders] <ProjectWiseFolder[]>] [-OIDCToken] <OIDCAuthToken> [[-ClearAssociation] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Remove-CloudProject [[-CloudProjectId] <string>] [-OIDCToken] <OIDCAuthToken> [[-ClearAssociation] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolders <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CloudProjectId <string>
        Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project ID
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OIDCToken <OIDCAuthToken>
        Token from Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ClearAssociation <SwitchParameter>
        Clear the Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project assocations to work areas. You must be logged into the datasources of the work areas in which there are associations
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline.
    
    System.String
        Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project ID
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Remove a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project associated with a chosen work area.
    New-PWLogin
    $OIDCToken=Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
    $WorkArea=Get-PWRichProjects -FolderPath (Show-PWFolderBrowserDialog).FullPath
    Remove-CloudProject -InputFolders $WorkArea -OIDCToken $OIDCToken
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    #Remove a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project given its ID.
    $OIDCToken=Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
    Remove-CloudProject -CloudProjectId xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx -OIDCToken $OIDCToken
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 3  ----------
    
    #Remove a Bentley Infrastructure Cloud project and clear the associations that are in Datasource1 and Datasource2.
    New-PWLogin -DatasourceName Datasource1 -BentleyIMS
    New-PWLogin -DatasourceName Datasource2 -BentleyIMS
    $OIDCToken=Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
    Remove-CloudProject -CloudProjectId xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx -ClearAssociation -OIDCToken $OIDCToken
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Remove-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnection


NAME
    Remove-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnection
    
SYNOPSIS
    Remove the identified work area connections for a given Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project. Will also take a rich project folder.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Remove-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnection [[-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]>] [[-CloudProjectId] <string>] [-OIDCToken] <OIDCAuthToken> [[-APIVersion] <string>] [[-ConnectionId] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Removes the identified work area connections for a given Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project. Will also take a rich project folder. NOTE: This cmdlet will delete work area connections but will not remove the actual association with a work area. To accomplish this, after using 
    consider Remove-PWConnectedProjectAssociation. Also the simpler cmdlet Remove-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnectionAndAssociation performs both tasks.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CloudProjectId <string>
        Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Project ID to query
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OIDCToken <OIDCAuthToken>
        Token from Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -APIVersion <string>
        API Version. Defaults to v1. Unless you are officially told otherwise, take the default.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                v1
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ConnectionId <string>
        Guid Work Area Connection Id
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    $oidcToken = Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://ims.bentley.com
    $folder = Get-PWFolderByURN 'pw://MyServerName:MyDatsoureName/Documents/P{xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx}/'
    $wacs = Get-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnections $folder -OIDCToken $oidcToken
    Remove-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnection $folder -OIDCToken $oidcToken -ConnectionId $wacs[0].Id
    
    
RELATED LINKS

        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Applications <string>
        Application(s) to remove. Comma separated list of applications or 'all'.

        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        Program(s) to remove. Enter comma separated list of programs or 'all'.
        
        Required?                    true

NAME

SYNOPSIS
    Remove-PWEnvironmentColumn removes a column from the specified environment within the current datasource.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Remove-PWEnvironmentColumn [-EnvironmentName] <string> [-ColumnName] <string> [-RemoveDatabaseColumn <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Removes a column from the specified environment within the current datasource. To delete the actual data, use the -RemoveDatabaseColumn switch.
    

PARAMETERS
    -EnvironmentName <string>
        Environment containing attribute (column) to be removed.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ColumnName <string>
        Name of column to be removed.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RemoveDatabaseColumn <SwitchParameter>
        When included, the database column and associated data will be deleted from the database table. Otherwise the column will just be deleted from the ProjectWise schema.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Example usage for removing a column from an environment.
    Remove-PWEnvironmentColumn -EnvironmentName 'Default' -ColumnName 'MyAttribute' -verbose
    This removes the column named MyAttribute from the 'Default' environment.
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    Example usage for removing a column from an environment, having the data deleted from the database and having the column removed from the databas structure.
    Remove-PWEnvironmentColumn -EnvironmentName 'Default' -ColumnName 'MyAttribute' -RemoveDatabaseColumn -verbose 
    This removes the column named MyAttribute from the 'Default' environment and makes the corresponding changes in the database.

## Remove-PWFolder


NAME
    Remove-PWFolder
    
SYNOPSIS
    Remove folders in a tree given folder path, folder id or array from pipeline. -RemoveFolders switch will just delete the empty leaf folders. -RemoveDocuments will just remove the documents in the given tree. Combine -RemoveFolders -RemoveDocuments to completely remove the tree.
    
    -ProceedWithDelete is a required parameter.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Remove-PWFolder [-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [[-RemoveDocuments] <SwitchParameter>] [[-RemoveFolders] <SwitchParameter>] [-ProceedWithDelete] <SwitchParameter> [[-DeletePasses] <int>] [[-AlternateFolderRemovalProcess] <int>] [[-FullPathToFileRemovalScript] <string>] 
    [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Remove-PWFolder [-FolderID] <int> [[-RemoveDocuments] <SwitchParameter>] [[-RemoveFolders] <SwitchParameter>] [-ProceedWithDelete] <SwitchParameter> [[-DeletePasses] <int>] [[-AlternateFolderRemovalProcess] <int>] [[-FullPathToFileRemovalScript] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Remove-PWFolder [[-FolderPath] <string>] [[-RemoveDocuments] <SwitchParameter>] [[-RemoveFolders] <SwitchParameter>] [-ProceedWithDelete] <SwitchParameter> [[-DeletePasses] <int>] [[-AlternateFolderRemovalProcess] <int>] [[-FullPathToFileRemovalScript] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderID <int>
        Folder ID for folder to be removed.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderPath <string>
        Folder Path.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RemoveDocuments <SwitchParameter>
        Set to remove documents.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RemoveFolders <SwitchParameter>
        Set to remove folders.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ProceedWithDelete <SwitchParameter>
        Required to proceed.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    3
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DeletePasses <int>
        Defaults to 10. Less is probably fine. More probably not required.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                10
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AlternateFolderRemovalProcess <int>
        Do not use.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false

        Accept pipeline input?       false

        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
    
    
OUTPUTS
    System.Boolean
    
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub-Folder' | Remove-PWFolder -RemoveDocuments -RemoveFolders -ProceedWithDelete
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    Remove-PWFolder -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub-Folder' -RemoveDocuments -RemoveFolders -ProceedWithDelete
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 3  ----------
    
    Remove-PWFolder -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub-Folder' -RemoveDocuments -RemoveFolders -ProceedWithDelete -DeletePasses 15

SYNOPSIS
    Removes the ability of Input Folder(s) and their children the ability to inerit configuration blocks from folders above.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Remove-PWManagedWorkspaceInheritanceForFolder [-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Removes the ability of Input Folder(s) and their children the ability to inerit configuration blocks from folders above. Folders can also be workareas. Since this capiblity applies to children, it would be better if none of the folders in input folders should be children of other 
    input folders.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Target folder object from pipeline or parameter.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Target folder object from pipeline or parameter.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    System.Boolean
    
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Turns off inerhitance of CSBs from folders above for Sub-Folder.
    Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub-Folder' -JustOne | Remove-PWManagedWorkspaceInheritanceForFolder -Verbose
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Remove-PWUserByMatch


NAME
    Remove-PWUserByMatch
    
SYNOPSIS
    Deletes provided users from the current ProjectWise datasource.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Remove-PWUserByMatch [-InputUsers] <User[]> [[-UserNameForItems] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Deletes provided users from the current ProjectWise datasource. You can provide a user account to replace the deleted user as items owner.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputUsers <User[]>
        Target user object(s) from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                Bentley.ProjectWise.PowerShell.Common.User[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -UserNameForItems <string>
        Specifies the user account to replace the old user as owner of documents, and other various items. If not included, the current user account is used.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    Bentley.ProjectWise.PowerShell.Common.User[]
        Target user object(s) from pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    The following will remove the specified user account. The current user will become owner of deleted users items.
    Remove-PWUserByMatch -InputUsers (Get-PWUsersByMatch -UserName 'TestUserToRemove') -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    The following will remove the specified user account. The specified UserNameForItems will will become owner of deleted users items.
    Remove-PWUserByMatch -InputUsers (Get-PWUsersByMatch -UserName 'TestUserToRemove') -UserNameForItems 'brian.flaherty@bentley.com' -Verbose
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Rename-PWDocument


NAME
    Rename-PWDocument
    
SYNOPSIS
    Rename-PWDocument renames the provided document object with the provided new document name. If the RenameFile switch parameter is included, the file name will be updated as well.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Rename-PWDocument [-InputDocument] <ProjectWiseDocument> [-DocumentNewName] <string> [-RenameFile <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Rename-PWDocument renames the provided document object with the provided new document name. If the RenameFile switch parameter is included, the file name will be updated as well.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocument <ProjectWiseDocument>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DocumentNewName <string>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RenameFile <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Renames the ProjectWise document passed via the pipeline to 'A111-View-4_Renamed.dwg'. Only the document name is changed.
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath 'TEST\New' -JustThisFolder -DocumentName 'A111-View-4.dwg' -Verbose |
                Rename-PWDocument -DocumentNewName 'A111-View-4_Renamed.dwg' -Verbose

                Rename-PWDocument -DocumentNewName 'A111-View-4_Renamed.dwg' -RenameFile -Verbose

## Rename-PWDocuments


NAME
    Rename-PWDocuments
    
SYNOPSIS
    Bulk update of document names and/or filenames.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Rename-PWDocuments [-InputDocument] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [-DocumentNamePart <string>] [-DocumentNameReplacement <string>] [-FileNamePart <string>] [-FileNameReplacement <string>] [-ReplaceDocumentNameWithFileName <bool>] [-ReplaceFileNameWithDocumentName <bool>] 
    [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Takes an array of document objects from the pipeline and allows you to replace part or all of the document name, or file name.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocument <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Array of documents to operate on.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ReplaceFileNameWithDocumentName <bool>
        Just replace the filename with the document name (preserves extension).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ReplaceDocumentNameWithFileName <bool>
        Just replace the document name with the filename.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DocumentNamePart <string>
        String to match in the document name. (e.g. "-A01-").
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FileNamePart <string>
        String to match in the file name. (e.g. "-A01-").
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DocumentNameReplacement <string>
        String to replace in the document name. (e.g. "-B02-").
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FileNameReplacement <string>
        String to replace in the file name. (e.g. "-B02-").
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Array of documents to operate on.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Get the documents in the given path and update them with the listed attributes. Also supports changing name and filename, but, of course, those must be unique in a folder.
    $docs = Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Folder 01\Sub-Folder 02"
    Rename-PWDocuments $docs -DocumentNamePart "-A01-" -DocumentNameReplacement "-B02-"

    Restore-PWManagedWorkspaceInheritanceForFolder [-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Restores the ability of Input Folder(s) and their children the ability to inerit configuration blocks from folders above. Folders can also be workareas. They should have this capability by default so the ony reason this cmdlet should be used would be to reverse the inheritance being 
    removed. Since this capiblity applies to children, it would be better if none of the folders in input folders should be children of other input folders.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Target folder object from pipeline or parameter.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Target folder object from pipeline or parameter.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    System.Boolean
    
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Turns inerhitance back on of CSBs from folders above for Sub-Folder.
    Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub-Folder' -JustOne | Restore-PWManagedWorkspaceInheritanceForFolder -Verbose

## Save-PWDocumentReport


NAME
    Save-PWDocumentReport
    
SYNOPSIS
    Saves a report of all the documents and metadata contained in a folder path or in a saved search.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Save-PWDocumentReport [[-ProjectWiseFolder] <string>] [[-SearchName] <string>] [[-AuditTrailRecordsEnd] <DateTime>] [[-AppendToXLSX] <SwitchParameter>] [[-Personal] <SwitchParameter>] [[-ExcludeSecondaryAuditTrail] <SwitchParameter>] [[-DocumentName] <string>] [[-FileName] <string>] 
    [[-FolderId] <int>] [[-OutputFileName] <string>] [[-IncludeVersions] <SwitchParameter>] [[-IncludeAuditTrail] <SwitchParameter>] [[-Fast] <SwitchParameter>] [[-AuditTrailRecordsSince] <DateTime>] [[-Recurse] <SwitchParameter>] [[-AuditTrailRecordsStart] <DateTime>] 
    [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Saves a report of all the documents and metadata contained in a folder path or in a saved search. Includes audit trail as well as records from backup audit trail table.
    
    Include neither path nor search name to report on whole datasource. Probably not a good idea to include audit trail in that case.
    
    Use the recurse parameter to include all sub-folders in the report.
    

PARAMETERS
    -ProjectWiseFolder <string>
        Path to the folder to report on (e.g. "PWPS Connected Project Test 6\Projects 2\Project A").
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SearchName <string>
        Name of saved search to report on (e.g. "60% Complete").
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderId <int>
        Folder Id of folder to report on.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OutputFileName <string>
        Full path to output XLSX file (e.g. "C:\temp\MyOutputfile.xlsx").
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeVersions <SwitchParameter>
        Include this switch to report on versions.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeAuditTrail <SwitchParameter>
        Include this switch to include the audit trail.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Fast <SwitchParameter>
        Fast Workbook generation at the price of excluding the hyperlinks.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AuditTrailRecordsSince <DateTime>
        If set, get audit trail records newer than this date.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    7
        Default value                1/1/0001 12:00:00 AM
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Recurse <SwitchParameter>
        When included, reports on all the documents within the specified folder and all sub-folders.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    8
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AuditTrailRecordsStart <DateTime>
        If set, include audit trail records newer than this date.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    9
        Default value                1/1/0001 12:00:00 AM
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AuditTrailRecordsEnd <DateTime>
        If set, include audit trail records older than this date.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    10
        Default value                1/1/0001 12:00:00 AM
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AppendToXLSX <SwitchParameter>
        Append to an existing XLSX file. Will force Fast output (no hyperlinks).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    11
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Personal <SwitchParameter>
        Look for a personal search.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    12
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ExcludeSecondaryAuditTrail <SwitchParameter>
        Don't include secondary audit trail records. Sometimes required for performance.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    13
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DocumentName <string>
        Document name. Supports % wild card.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    14
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FileName <string>
        File name. Supports % wild card.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    15
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Example usage for reporting on documents.
    #Will report on the documents ONLY in the folder identified by the folder path.
    Save-PWDocumentReport -ProjectWiseFolder "PWPS Connected Project Test 6\Projects 2\Project A" -OutputFileName "c:\\temp\\xmittalReport.xlsx"
    #Will report on the documents ONLY in the folder identified by the folder path. Will include audit trail and versions.
    Save-PWDocumentReport -ProjectWiseFolder "PWPS Connected Project Test 6\Projects 2\Project A" -IncludeVersions -IncludeAuditTrail -OutputFileName "c:\\temp\\xmittalReport.xlsx"
    #Will report on the documents in the folder and all sub-folders identified by the folder path. Will include audit trail and versions.
    Save-PWDocumentReport -ProjectWiseFolder "PWPS Connected Project Test 6\Projects 2\Project A" -IncludeVersions -Recurse -IncludeAuditTrail -OutputFileName "c:\\temp\\xmittalReport.xlsx"
    #Will report on the documents in the saved search including the audit trail (will only include versions if they are included in search)
    Save-PWDocumentReport -SearchName "60% Complete" -IncludeAuditTrail -OutputFileName "c:\\temp\\xmittalReport.xlsx"
    #Will report on the documents in the folder and all sub-folders identified by the folder path. Will include audit trail between the given dates, will include versions and will output to a SQLite database.
    Save-PWDocumentReport -ProjectWiseFolder "PWPS Connected Project Test 6\Projects 2\Project A" -IncludeVersions -Recurse -IncludeAuditTrail -OutputFileName "c:\\temp\\xmittalReport.sqlite" -AuditTrailRecordsStart 2015-01-01 -AuditTrailRecordEnd 2015-12-31
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Save-PWDocumentsToDataTable


NAME
    Save-PWDocumentsToDataTable
    
SYNOPSIS
    Create an arry of data tables suitable for output to Excel or SQLite from an array of document objects like that returned from Get-PWDocumentsBySearch.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Save-PWDocumentsToDataTable [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [[-IncludeAttributes] <SwitchParameter>] [[-IncludeAuditTrail] <SwitchParameter>] [[-AuditTrailRecordsStart] <DateTime>] [[-AuditTrailRecordsEnd] <DateTime>] [[-ExcludeSecondaryAuditTrail] <SwitchParameter>] 
    [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Create an arry of data tables suitable for output to Excel or SQLite from an array of document objects like that returned from Get-PWDocumentsBySearch.
    
    Optionally include audit trail and optionall set date range for audit trail.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Input array of ProjectWiseDocument objects from the pipeline (Required). Use Get-PWDocumentBySearch or New-PWDocument to feed pipeline.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeAttributes <SwitchParameter>
        Include this switch to include attributes in the returned tables.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeAuditTrail <SwitchParameter>
        Include this switch to include the audit trail.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AuditTrailRecordsStart <DateTime>
        If set, include audit trail records newer than this date.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                1/1/0001 12:00:00 AM
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AuditTrailRecordsEnd <DateTime>
        If set, include audit trail records older than this date.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                1/1/0001 12:00:00 AM
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ExcludeSecondaryAuditTrail <SwitchParameter>
        Include this switch to include the audit trail.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Input array of ProjectWiseDocument objects from the pipeline (Required). Use Get-PWDocumentBySearch or New-PWDocument to feed pipeline.
    
    System.Management.Automation.SwitchParameter
        Include this switch to include attributes in the returned tables.
    
    System.Management.Automation.SwitchParameter
        Include this switch to include the audit trail.
    
    System.DateTime
        If set, include audit trail records newer than this date.
    
    System.DateTime
        If set, include audit trail records older than this date.
    
    System.Management.Automation.SwitchParameter
        Include this switch to include the audit trail.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    System.Data.DataTable[]
    
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Get documents from search, Convert to an array of data tables including attributes and audit trail, Create XLSX file from DataTables.
    $docs = Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -SearchName "All PDFs"
    $dts = Save-PWDocumentsToDataTable -IncludeAuditTrail -IncludeAttributes 
    New-XLSXWorkbook $dts -OutputFileName d:\Export\AllPDFs.xlsx
    #Output to SQLite database.
    foreach ($dt in $ds) {
          $dt2 = $dt.Copy()
          Export-DataTableToSQLiteDB -SourceDataTable $dt2 -OutputFolder D:\DMOutput7 -OutputFileName SAR04.sqlite -Append
    }

DESCRIPTION

## Send-PWDocumentsToAdobeSign


NAME
    Send-PWDocumentsToAdobeSign
    
SYNOPSIS
    Send documents to AdobeSign for digital signatures.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Send-PWDocumentsToAdobeSign [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [-Token] <string> [[-URL] <string>] [[-SigningEmails] <string[]>] [[-SigningMessage] <string>] [[-AdobeIntegrationKey] <string>] [-AgreementName] <string> [[-CreatorEmail] <string>] [[-WebEdit] <SwitchParameter>] 
    [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Documents to send to Adobe Sign (Required).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Token <string>
        Token for authenticating with Web API. For logical credentials this will be of the form $basic = "Basic $(ConvertTo-EncodedToken "user.name:password")" for IMS users use $imsToken = "Token $(ConvertTo-EncodedToken $(Get-PWConnectionClientToken -UsePWRelyingParty))"
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -URL <string>
        Address of web service. Should be something like https://server-ws.bentley.com/ProjectWiseWebAPIServiceCore. If blank, default URL configured with Set-PWAdobeSignParameters will be used.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SigningEmails <string[]>
        Signing Emails. List of emails to send the agreement to. Ignored for -WebEdit.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SigningMessage <string>
        Signing Message. If blank, default will be used.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AdobeIntegrationKey <string>
        Adobe Integration Key. If blank, default will be used. Adobe Integration Key. In Adobe Sign Account portal go to Account>Personal Preferences>Access Tokens to generate. Address is https://secure.na1.echosign.com/account/accountSettingsPage#pageId::ACCESS_TOKENS. If not provided 
        will be read from datasource settings registered with Set-PWAdobeSignParameters.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AgreementName <string>
        Agreement name.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    7
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -CreatorEmail <string>
        Creator Email. If blank, current user's email will be used.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    8
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WebEdit <SwitchParameter>
        If set, use the Web Edit endpoint, otherwise use regular signing endpoint.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    9
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Documents to send to Adobe Sign (Required).
    
    System.String
        Token for authenticating with Web API. For logical credentials this will be of the form $basic = "Basic $(ConvertTo-EncodedToken "user.name:password")" for IMS users use $imsToken = "Token $(ConvertTo-EncodedToken $(Get-PWConnectionClientToken -UsePWRelyingParty))"
    
    System.String
        Address of web service. Should be something like https://server-ws.bentley.com/ProjectWiseWebAPIServiceCore. If blank, default URL configured with Set-PWAdobeSignParameters will be used.
    
    System.String[]
        Signing Emails. List of emails to send the agreement to. Ignored for -WebEdit.
    
    System.String
        Signing Message. If blank, default will be used.
    
    System.String
        Adobe Integration Key. If blank, default will be used. Adobe Integration Key. In Adobe Sign Account portal go to Account>Personal Preferences>Access Tokens to generate. Address is https://secure.na1.echosign.com/account/accountSettingsPage#pageId::ACCESS_TOKENS. If not provided 
        will be read from datasource settings registered with Set-PWAdobeSignParameters.
    
    System.String
        Agreement name.
    
    System.String
        Creator Email. If blank, current user's email will be used.
    
    System.Management.Automation.SwitchParameter
        If set, use the Web Edit endpoint, otherwise use regular signing endpoint.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    $docs = New-PWPDFDocuments -ProjectWiseFolderPath "Adobe Sign\PDFs" -StorageArea Storage -NuumberOfFiles 10 -NumberOfWords 20
    $docsSubset = @($docs[0], $docs[1], $docs[2})
    $fedToken = Get-PWConnectionClientToken -UsePWRelyingParty
    $encToken = ConvertTo-EncodedToken $fedToken
    $authVal = "Token " + $encToken
    $today = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"
    $agreementName = $today + " " + (Get-RandomString -Length 6 -Characters "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")
    Send-PWDocumentsToAdobeSign $docsSubset -Token $authVal -AgreementName $agreementName -SigningMessage "Please sign $agreementName" -SigningEmails "powershell.user2@eagle.bentley.com","powershell.user1@gmail.com"

    Set-PWCustomStringSetting
    
SYNOPSIS
    Set value for custom string setting at the datasource level.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWCustomStringSetting [-SettingID] <int> [-Value] <string> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -SettingID <int>
        Setting ID (normally negative number for custom settings).
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Value <string>
        Value to set for custom setting.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216).

OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
