## Set-PWDocumentApplication


NAME
    Set-PWDocumentApplication
    
SYNOPSIS
    Sets the application associated with a document.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWDocumentApplication [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [-Application] <string> [[-ChangeVersionApplications] <SwitchParameter>] [[-ChangeFinalStatusApplications] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Takes a document object from the pipeline and sets the associated application.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Array of document objects like that from Get-PWDocumentsBySearch.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Application <string>
        Name of application to associate with document.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ChangeVersionApplications <SwitchParameter>
        Change application of old versions passed, too.
        
        Requires current user to be an administrator.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ChangeFinalStatusApplications <SwitchParameter>
        Change application of documents with final status set.
        
        Requires current user to be an administrator.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Array of document objects like that from Get-PWDocumentsBySearch.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Sets the associated application to MicroStation for the specified documents.
    $docs = Show-PWDocumentSelectionDialog -FileExtension 'dgn' -Verbose
                Set-PWDocumentApplication -InputDocuments $docs -Application MicroStation -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    Sets the associated application to MicroStation for the documents passed via the pipeline.
    $docs = Show-PWDocumentSelectionDialog -FileExtension 'dgn' -Verbose |
                Set-PWDocumentApplication -Application MicroStation -Verbose
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Set-PWDocumentFinalStatus


NAME
    Set-PWDocumentFinalStatus
    
SYNOPSIS
    Sets or removes a document's final status.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWDocumentFinalStatus [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [[-RemoveFinalStatus] <SwitchParameter>] [[-Comment] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RemoveFinalStatus <SwitchParameter>
        Set to clear final status.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Comment <string>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Set final status for all documents in a folder.
    #Get all the documents in this folder tree and set them to final status
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Test 6\Projects 2"  | Set-PWDocumentFinalStatus
    #Get all the documents in this folder tree and clear final status
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Test 6\Projects 2"  | Set-PWDocumentFinalStatus -RemoveFinalStatus

## Set-PWDocumentGeoSpatialLocation


NAME
    Set-PWDocumentGeoSpatialLocation
    
SYNOPSIS
    Very simple location assignment for documents. Takes an array of document objects and assigns a block or a point on the input Lat/Long or Address and box size.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWDocumentGeoSpatialLocation [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [[-Latitude] <double>] [[-Longitude] <double>] [[-SizeOfBoxInDegrees] <double>] [[-Point] <SwitchParameter>] [[-Address] <string>] [[-WKT] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Array of folder objects from the pipeline.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Latitude <double>
        Latitude in decimal degrees.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Longitude <double>
        Longitude in decimal degrees.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                0
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SizeOfBoxInDegrees <double>
        Size of box in decimal degrees. Defaults to a 10th of a second.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                2.77777777777778E-05
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Point <SwitchParameter>
        Set to mark with a point rather than a polygon.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Address <string>
        Address to lookup via Google and assign geo-location to document.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WKT <string>
        Well Known Text string describing polygon.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Array of folder objects from the pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Example usage. Find documents, assign a location to them.
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "My Locations\Folder 2" -FileName %.dgn | Set-PWDocumentGeoSpatialLocation -Latitude 45 -Longitude 90 
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "My Locations\Folder 2" -FileName %.dgn | Set-PWDocumentGeoSpatialLocation -Address "704 15th Street, Durham, NC" -Point
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Set-PWDocumentGroupAccess


NAME
    Set-PWDocumentGroupAccess
    
SYNOPSIS
    Set group access for one or more input documents.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWDocumentGroupAccess [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [-Group] <string> [-Access] <string[]> [[-ApplyToVersions] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Target document object(s) from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Group <string>
        Group to apply access for.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Access <string[]>
        Access specifies the access control to be applied.
        
        The available entries are:
        
        fc - full control,
        
        cp - change permissions,
        
        c - create,
        
        d - delete,
        
        r - read,
        
        w - write,
        
        cw - change workflow,
        
        fr - file read,
        
        fw - file write,
        
        f - free,
        
        na - no access
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ApplyToVersions <SwitchParameter>
        Apply the security to versions of the input documents.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Target document object(s) from pipeline.
    
    System.String
        Group to apply access for.
    
    System.String[]
        Access specifies the access control to be applied.
        
        The available entries are:
        
        fc - full control,
        
        cp - change permissions,
        
        c - create,
        
        d - delete,
        
        r - read,
        
        w - write,
        
        cw - change workflow,
        
        fr - file read,
        
        fw - file write,
        
        f - free,
        
        na - no access
    
    System.Management.Automation.SwitchParameter
        Apply the security to versions of the input documents.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    $targetDocs = Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Target Documents\Folder 1"
    Set-PWDocumentGroupAccess $targetDocs -Group 'Drafters' -Access 'r','w','fr','fw'
    Set-PWDocumentGroupAccess $targetDocs -Group 'Project Managers' -Access 'na'

## Set-PWDocumentState


NAME
    Set-PWDocumentState
    
SYNOPSIS
    Sets a document's workflow state.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWDocumentState [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [-State] <string> [[-ChangeVersionStates] <SwitchParameter>] [[-SkipIntermediateStates] <SwitchParameter>] [[-ChangeFinalStatusStates] <SwitchParameter>] [[-IgnoreStatus] <SwitchParameter>] [[-Force] <SwitchParameter>] 
    [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Takes a document object from the pipeline and sets it to the indicated workflow state.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -State <string>
        Name of state to change to.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ChangeVersionStates <SwitchParameter>
        Change state of old versions passed, too.
        
        Requires current user to be an administrator.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SkipIntermediateStates <SwitchParameter>
        Go directly to passed state and don't pass through intermediate states.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ChangeFinalStatusStates <SwitchParameter>
        Change state of documents with final status set.
        
        Requires current user to be an administrator.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IgnoreStatus <SwitchParameter>
        Change state of exported or checked out documents.
        
        Requires current user to be an administrator.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Force <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Setting all the documents in a folder to a given state.
    #Get all the documents in this folder and set them to state 'Completed'
    #Skipping intermediate states, changing the states of old version, changing the states of documents with final status,
    #and changing the status of checked out and exported documents. User must be administator for special switches to work.
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Test 6\Projects 2" -GetVersionsToo -JustThisFolder | Set-PWDocumentState -State 'Completed' -SkipIntermediateStates -ChangeVersionStates -ChangeFinalStatusStates -IgnoreStatus
    
    
RELATED LINKS

    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    The following will set the minimum file size to 25 for Point Cloud file streaming.
    Set-PWFileStreamingMinimumFileSize -FileStreamingType PointCloud -MinimumSize 25 -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    The following will set the minimum file size to 50 for both PointCloud and Raster.
    Set-PWFileStreamingMinimumFileSize -FileStreamingType All -MinimumSize 50 -Verbose
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Set-PWInterfaceGUIDefinition


NAME
    Set-PWInterfaceGUIDefinition
    
SYNOPSIS
    Set-PWInterfaceGUIDefinition allows you to add Environment attribute(s) to an Interface. Designed to facilate copying interface definitions from one datasource to another. However, can be used in the same datasource.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWInterfaceGUIDefinition [-GUIDefinition] <DataTable> -EnvironmentName <string> -InterfaceName <string> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    The Set-PWInterfaceGUIDefinition cmdlet allows you to add Environment attribute(s) to an existing Interface. Use the Get-PWInterfaceGUIDefinition cmdlet to get the desired interface definition information and use the ConvertTo-Datatable cmdlet to convert it to the correct format 
    required.
    

PARAMETERS
    -GUIDefinition <DataTable>
        Environment to use to get Interface definition for.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EnvironmentName <string>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -InterfaceName <string>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    The following will get the gui definition for the 'Designer' interface from the 'Simple' environment and populate the $pwGUI variable. 
    Then, convert the gui definition to a datatable, and finally update the 'Default' interface. The result should be a matching interface layout.
    $pwGUI = Get-PWInterfaceGUIDefinition -EnvironmentName 'Simple' -InterfaceName 'Designer'
    Set-PWInterfaceGUIDefinition -GUIDefinition(ConvertTo-Datatable $pwGUI) -EnvironmentName 'Simple' -InterfaceName 'Default' -Verbose

## Set-PWManagedWorkspaceForFolders

    Set-PWManagedWorkspaceForFolders

    Associates the specified Managed Workspace Configuration Block to the Input Folder(s).
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWManagedWorkspaceForFolders [-InputFolders] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [-WorkspaceType] <string> [-ConfigBlockName] <string> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolders <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Target folder object(s) from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WorkspaceType <string>
        Select the type of Managed Workspace containing the desired configuration settings block to be used. Valid entries: "Predefined", "Global", "Application", "Customer", "Site", "Workspace", "WorkSet", "Project", "Role", "User"
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ConfigBlockName <string>
        Name of configuration block to be added to project. Use Get-PWManagedWorkspaceConfigBlocks to get a list of available configuration blocks.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Target folder object(s) from pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Associates MyConfigBlockName to the folder's Managed Workspace type Workset/Project.
    Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub-Folder' -JustOne | 
                Set-PWManagedWorkspaceForFolders -WorkspaceType 'WorkSet' -ConfigBlockName 'MyConfigBlockName' -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    Associates MyConfigBlockName to each of the folder's Managed Workspace type Workset/Project.
    $folders = Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub-Folder'
                Set-PWManagedWorkspaceForFolders -InputFolders $folders -WorkspaceType 'WorkSet' -ConfigBlockName 'MyConfigBlockName' -Verbose

## Set-PWRichProjectResource


NAME
    Set-PWRichProjectResource
    
SYNOPSIS
    Set-PWRichProjectResource is used to manipulate the rich project resources for a specified project.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWRichProjectResource [[-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]>] [-ResourceType] <string> [[-ResourceMemberName] <string>] [-Inherit <SwitchParameter>] [-None <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Set-PWRichProjectResource [-FolderPath] <string> [-ResourceType] <string> [[-ResourceMemberName] <string>] [-Inherit <SwitchParameter>] [-None <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Set-PWRichProjectResource is used to manipulate the rich project resources for a specified project. A resource type can be set to inherit, none or add specific resource members.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderPath <string>
        Specifies the rich project to set the resource data for.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ResourceType <string>
        Specifies the resource type to set.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ResourceMemberName <string>
        Specifies the name of the resource to set. Valid Entries will the name of one of the members of the specified resource type.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Inherit <SwitchParameter>
        When included, the resource type will be set to inherit.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -None <SwitchParameter>
        When included, the resource type will be set to none. If both inherit and none are included, inherit will take precedence.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline.
    
    System.String
        Specifies the rich project to set the resource data for.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Example usage for setting a project's application resource to inherit.
    Set-PWRichProjectResource -FolderPath 'Projects' -ResourceType 'application' -Inherit
    #Example usage for setting a project's workspace profiles resource to none.
    Set-PWRichProjectResource -FolderPath 'Projects' -ResourceType 'workspaceprofile' -None
    #Example usage for adding the MicroStation application to the project's application resources.
    Set-PWRichProjectResource -FolderPath 'Projects' -ResourceType 'application' -ResourceMemberName 'Microstation'

## Set-PWWorkAreaConnectionDisabledOIDC


NAME
    Set-PWWorkAreaConnectionDisabledOIDC
    
SYNOPSIS
    Disables Work Area Connections in order to hide unused connections from users. Requires https://imsoidc.bentley.com authority for the token.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWWorkAreaConnectionDisabledOIDC [-OIDCToken] <OIDCAuthToken> [[-ConnectedProjectId] <string>] [[-WorkAreaConnectionId] <string>] [[-Enable] <SwitchParameter>] [[-PreserveName] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -OIDCToken <OIDCAuthToken>
        Pass access_token part of OIDC Token returned from Get-OIDCToken cmdlet. Authority https://imsoidc.bentley.com. Required.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ConnectedProjectId <string>
        Connected/PW365 Project Id.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WorkAreaConnectionId <string>
        Work Area Connection Id.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Enable <SwitchParameter>
        Enable instead of disable.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -PreserveName <SwitchParameter>
        When disabling, probably really want to set to a new, random name in order to eliminate conflicts.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    $oidcToken = Get-OIDCToken -Authority https://imsoidc.bentley.com
    $wacs = Get-PWWorkAreaConnectionsOIDC -ConnectedProjectIds '8136211F-C83B-4388-A59C-1D657734CD4F' -OIDCToken $oidcToken 
    Set-PWWorkAreaConnectionDisabledOIDC '8136211F-C83B-4388-A59C-1D657734CD4F' -WorkAreaConnectionId $wacs[0].id -OIDCToken $oidcToken

## Set-PWWorkAreaConnectionUserSync


NAME
    Set-PWWorkAreaConnectionUserSync
    
SYNOPSIS
    Change User Sync setting for Work Area Connections. Requires OIDC token created using https://imsoidc.bentley.com authority
    
    
SYNTAX
    Set-PWWorkAreaConnectionUserSync [[-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]>] [-Token] <string> [[-ConnectedProjectIds] <string[]>] [-OIDCToken] <OIDCAuthToken> [[-WSGVersion] <string>] [[-NoUserSync] <SwitchParameter>] [[-Automatic] <SwitchParameter>] [[-SetPrimary] <SwitchParameter>] 
    [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Token <string>
        Pass base 64 encoded token from Get-PWConnectionClientToken (do not use -UseRelyingParty) or from Get-PWNonFederatedLoginToken -CreateWebToken.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ConnectedProjectIds <string[]>
        List of Connected Project Ids.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                System.String[]
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OIDCToken <OIDCAuthToken>
        Pass access_token property from object returned by Get-OIDCToken.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WSGVersion <string>
        WSG Version. Defaults to v2.5.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                v2.5
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NoUserSync <SwitchParameter>
        Set this flag to NOT enable user sync
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SetPrimary <SwitchParameter>
        Set this flag to NOT enable user sync
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Automatic <SwitchParameter>
        Set this flag have the work area participants automatically sync to the project. WAC must be primary
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Example usage for setting User Sync on for the Work Area Connections.
    $oidcToken = Get-OIDCToken #blocks until you authenticate via web browser
    $token = Get-PWConnectionClientToken #gets token from Connection Client
    $connProj = Get-PWConnectedProjectId (Get-PWFolderByURN 'pw://decide-pwce-us.bentley.com:decide-pwce-us-10/Documents/P{56b5a7e4-9b35-4f63-b3a9-59356205a25b}/')
    $newWacs = Get-PWWorkAreaConnectionsOIDC -ConnectedProjectIds $connProj -OIDCToken $oidcToken.access_token
    $wacs = Get-PWWorkAreaConnections (Get-PWFolderByURN 'pw://decide-pwce-us.bentley.com:decide-pwce-us-10/Documents/P{56b5a7e4-9b35-4f63-b3a9-59356205a25b}/') -Token $token
    Set-PWWorkAreaConnectionUserSync -ConnectedProjectIds $connProj -OIDCToken $oidcToken -Token $token

    Submit-PWDocumentToPrint [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [[-Wait] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]

        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,

    $defprinter01=Get-WMIObject Win32_Printer | Where{$_.Default -eq $true}
    $defprinter02=Get-WMIObject Win32_Printer | Where{$_.Name -eq "HP Laser Jet"}
    $defprinter02.SetDefaultPrinter()
    Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub-Folder' -FileName %.pdf | Submit-PWPDFPrint -Verbose
    $defprinter01.SetDefaultPrinter()

    $folder = Get-PWFolderByURN 'URNtoWorkAreaWithWorkAreaConnections'
    $wacs = Get-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnections $folder -OIDCToken $oidcToken
    Update-CloudProjectWorkAreaConnections $folder -OIDCToken $oidcToken -ConnectionId $wacs[0].Id -SetDriveSync

## Update-PWDocumentFile


NAME
    Update-PWDocumentFile
    
SYNOPSIS
    The Update-PWDocumentFile cmdlet offers a method to replace the associated physical file with file from the local system for a ProjectWise document. Documents need to be passed via the PowerShell pipeline as a ProjectWiseDocument type.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWDocumentFile [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [-NewFilePathName] <string> [[-NewFileName] <string>] [-RemoveFile <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Update-PWDocumentFile [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [-NewFilePathName] <string> [-KeepExistingFileName <SwitchParameter>] [-RemoveFile <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Target document object(s) from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewFilePathName <string>
        Replacement file path.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewFileName <string>
        New file name to apply.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -KeepExistingFileName <SwitchParameter>
        When included, the existing file name will be used regardless of the name of the specified file.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RemoveFile <SwitchParameter>
        If set, remove the existing file leaving the document as an abstract document.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Target document object(s) from pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Example usage replacing physical file.
    The following will replace the existing file associated with the ProjectWise document(s) The file name of the specified file will be used.
      Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Examples" -DocumentName "A111.dwg" -JustThisFolder -Verbose |
                    Update-PWDocumentFile -NewFilePathName "D:\TEMP\Export\A111_Updated.dwg" -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    #Example usage replacing physical file and renaming using document name.
    The following will replace the existing file associated with the ProjectWise document(s) and rename using the new file name.
      Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Examples" -DocumentName "A111.dwg" -JustThisFolder -Verbose |
                    Update-PWDocumentFile -NewFilePathName "D:\TEMP\Export\A111_Updated.dwg" -NewFileName "A111_UpdatedFile.dwg" -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 3  ----------
    
    #Example usage replacing physical file and renaming with specified new name.
    The following will replace the existing file associated with the ProjectWise document(s) and keep the original associated file name.
      Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath "Examples" -DocumentName "A111.dwg" -JustThisFolder -Verbose |
                    Update-PWDocumentFile -NewFilePathName "D:\TEMP\Export\A111_Updated.dwg" -KeepExistingFileName -Verbose
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Update-PWDocumentFileFromProjectWise


NAME
    Update-PWDocumentFileFromProjectWise
    
SYNOPSIS
    The Update-PWDocumentFileFromProjectWise cmdlet offers a method to replace the associated physical file with file from another document within the current ProjectWise datasource. Documents need to be passed via the PowerShell pipeline as a ProjectWiseDocument type.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWDocumentFileFromProjectWise [-InputDocuments] <ProjectWiseDocument[]> [-PWFolderPath] <string> [-PWFileName] <string> [-KeepExistingFileName <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputDocuments <ProjectWiseDocument[]>
        Target document object(s) from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -PWFolderPath <string>
        Folder containing the document, whose file will be used to replace file with.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -PWFileName <string>
        File name of the file associated with a document in PWFolder which will be used as the replacement. If it contains wildcards, it must match only one file.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -KeepExistingFileName <SwitchParameter>
        When included, the existing file name will be used regardless of the name of the specified file.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
        Target document object(s) from pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseDocument[]
    
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Example usage replacing physical file.
    The following will replace the existing file associated with the ProjectWise document(s). The existing file name will be replaced with the new file name.
      $pwDocuments = Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath 'PowerShell\DocsToReplaceFile' -JustThisFolder |
                    Update-PWDocumentFileFromProjectWise -PWFolderPath 'PowerShell\Docs' -PWFileName 'Cmdlets - LookupTables.pdf' -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    #Example usage replacing physical file and renaming using document name.
    The following will replace the existing file associated with the ProjectWise document(s). The existing file name will be used.
      $pwDocuments = Get-PWDocumentsBySearch -FolderPath 'PowerShell\DocsToReplaceFile' -JustThisFolder |
                    Update-PWDocumentFileFromProjectWise -PWFolderPath 'PowerShell\Docs' -PWFileName 'Cmdlets - LookupTables.pdf' -KeepExistingFileName -Verbose

## Update-PWFolderSecurity


NAME
    Update-PWFolderSecurity
    
SYNOPSIS
    Update-PWFolderSecurity is used to add user(s), group(s), or userlist(s) access control to specified folders.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWFolderSecurity [-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [-MemberType] <string> [[-MemberName] <string[]>] [[-MemberAccess] <string[]>] [-DocumentSecurity <SwitchParameter>] [-FolderSecurity <SwitchParameter>] [-IncludeInheritance <SwitchParameter>] [-StateName <string>] 
    [-WorkFlowName <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Update-PWFolderSecurity [-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [-MemberType] <string> [[-MemberName] <string[]>] [[-MemberAccessString] <string>] [-DocumentSecurity <SwitchParameter>] [-FolderSecurity <SwitchParameter>] [-IncludeInheritance <SwitchParameter>] [-StateName <string>] 
    [-WorkFlowName <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Update-PWFolderSecurity [-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [-MemberType] <string> [[-MemberName] <string[]>] [[-Role] <string>] [-IncludeInheritance <SwitchParameter>] [-StateName <string>] [-WorkFlowName <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    The Membertype specifies whether access should be applied for a user, group, or userlist.
    
    Valid entries:
    
    For users: "u", "user"
    
    For groups: "g", "group"
    
    For userlists: "ul", "userlist"
    
    For Everyone: "Everyone"
    
    The MemberAccess specifies the access control to be applied.
    
    Valid entries:
    
    fc - full control,
    
    cp - change permissions,
    
    c - create,
    
    d - delete,
    
    r - read,
    
    w - write,
    
    cw - change workflow,
    
    fr - file read,
    
    fw - file write,
    
    f - free,
    
    na - no access
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        The InputFolders parameter contains the folder(s) to apply the access control to.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MemberType <string>
        The Membertype specifies whether access should be applied
        
        for a user, group, or userlist
        
        Valid entries are
        
        For users: "u", "User"
        
        For groups: "g", "Group"
        
        For userlists: "ul", "UserList"
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MemberName <string[]>
        Name of user, group or userlist
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MemberAccess <string[]>
        The MemberAccess specifies the access control to be applied.
        
        The available entries are:
        
        fc - full control,
        
        cp - change permissions,
        
        c - create,
        
        d - delete,
        
        r - read,
        
        w - write,
        
        cw - change workflow,
        
        fr - file read,
        
        fw - file write,
        
        f - free,
        
        na - no access
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MemberAccessString <string>
        The MemberAccessString specifies an 11 character mask representing the access control to be applied. This parameter is an alternative to MemberAccess. Both may not be used together.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Role <string>
        The role name to be applied. Valid roles are:
        
        "Project Administrator"
        
        "Project Leader"
        
        "Team Member"
        
        "Project Observer"
        
        "No Access"
        
        "(Roles resolve to a specific set of rights on a project)"
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderSecurity <SwitchParameter>
        Apply Folder Security.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DocumentSecurity <SwitchParameter>
        Apply Document Security.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WorkFlowName <string>
        Name of workflow to apply access control to.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -StateName <string>
        Name of workflow state to apply access control to.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IncludeInheritance <SwitchParameter>
        When included, if access control is being inherited, it will be added directly to the folder or document security.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        The InputFolders parameter contains the folder(s) to apply the access control to.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    The following example will update the security for the folders being passed via the pipeline, project/folder security only.
    The user will be added with create, read, write, and delete permissions.
    PS C:\>Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Projects' -Slow | 
    Update‐PWFolderSecurity ‐MemberType ʺuʺ ‐MemberName “username” ‐MemberAccess “c”, “r”, “w”, “d” ‐FolderSecurity -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    The following example will update the security for the one folder, both project/folder and document security.
    The group, New Group, will be added with read, write for project/folder and read, write, file read, and file write permissions.
    PS C:\>Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Projects' -JustOne -Slow |  
    Update‐PWFolderSecurity ‐MemberType ʺgʺ ‐MemberName “New Group” ‐MemberAccess “r”, “w”, “fr”, “fw” ‐FolderSecurity ‐DocumentSecurity -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 3  ----------
    
    The following example will update the security for the folders being passed via the pipeline, document security only.
    The userlist, All_Users will be added with read, file read permissions.
    PS C:\>Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Projects' -Slow |  
    Update‐PWFolderSecurity ‐MemberType ʺulʺ ‐MemberName “All_Users” ‐MemberAccess “r”, “fr” ‐DocumentSecurity -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 4  ----------
    
    The following example will update the security for the folders passed via the pipeline, document security only.
    The userlist, All_Users will be added with read, file read permissions.
    PS C:\>Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Projects' -Slow |  
    Update‐PWFolderSecurity ‐MemberType ʺulʺ ‐MemberName “All_Users” ‐Role “Project Observer” -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 5  ----------
    
    The following example will update the security for the specified folder to include the inherited access control.
    Both folder and document security will be updated. The userlist, All_Users will be added with read, file read permissions.
    PS C:\>Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Projects' -JustOne -Slow | 
    Update‐PWFolderSecurity ‐MemberType ʺulʺ ‐MemberName “All_Users” ‐Role “Project Observer” -IncludeInheritance -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 6  ----------
    
    The following example will update the security for the specified folder to include the inherited access control.
    Both folder and document security will be updated. The 'Everyone' user will be added with the role of Project Observer.
    PS C:\>Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Projects' -JustOne -Slow | 
    Update‐PWFolderSecurity ‐MemberType ʺEveryoneʺ ‐Role “Project Observer” -IncludeInheritance -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 7  ----------
    
    The following example will update the security for the specified folder to include the specified access control.
    Both folder and document security will be updated. The 'psUserList1' userlist will be added with the --CDrw-RWf- access control.
    PS C:\>Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Projects' -JustOne -Slow | 
    Update‐PWFolderSecurity ‐MemberType 'UserList' -MemberAccessString '--CDrw-RWf-' -FolderSecurity -DocumentSecurity -IncludeInheritance -Verbose

## Update-PWGroupProperties

    Update-PWGroupProperties
    
SYNOPSIS
    Updates the provided group name, description and / or whether group membership is updated by IMS claims.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWGroupProperties [-InputGroup] <ProjectWiseGroup> [[-NewGroupName] <string>] [[-NewGroupDescription] <string>] [[-MembershipIsUpdatedBySTS] <bool>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputGroup <ProjectWiseGroup>
        Group object from the pipeline to update.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewGroupName <string>
        New ProjectWise Group name.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewGroupDescription <string>
        New ProjectWise Group description.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -MembershipIsUpdatedBySTS <bool>
        Sets Value for the Update Membership By IMS Claims Setting to $true or $false.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216).

    PWWrapper+ProjectWiseGroup
        Group object from the pipeline to update.

    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------

               $pwGroupName     = 'PSTest'
               $pwGroupName_New = 'PowerShell_Test'
               $pwGroupDesc_New = 'PowerShell Test Group'
               
               $pwGroup = Get-PWGroups -GroupName $pwGroupName
               $Splat_Update = @{
                   InputGroup          = $pwGroup
                   NewGroupName        = $pwGroupName_New
                   NewGroupDescription = $pwGroupDesc_New
               }
               Update-PWGroupProperties @Splat_Update -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    The following will update the group name for the piped group object.  It will also set the group to have its membership updated by IMS claims.
                Get-PWGroups -GroupName $pwGroupName | 
                Update-PWGroupProperties -NewGroupName $pwGroupName_New -MembershipIsUpdatedBySTS $true -Verbose

        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        New name to update workspace configuration block with.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewDescription <string>
        New description to update workspace configuration block with.
        
        Required?                    false

        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

## Update-PWPropagateProjectProperties


NAME
    Update-PWPropagateProjectProperties
    
SYNOPSIS
    Given an array of folder objects on the pipeline or folder path, update the contained documents to the new project properties. Passes out project documents onto the pipeline.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWPropagateProjectProperties [[-InputFolders] <ProjectWiseFolder[]>] [[-FolderPath] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolders <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Target folder object(s) from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderPath <string>
        Target folder path (not required if sending folder(s) on pipeline).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Target folder object(s) from pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Example usage getting folders and creating new documents.
    #Get the folder for folder number 20315 and update contained documents to new project property values
    Get-PWFolders 20315 | Update-PWPropagateProjectProperties
    #Get the folder at the given folder path and create a document there
    Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Level 1\Level 2\Level 3\Level | Update-PWPropagateProjectProperties
    #Update document attributes for a given folder
    Update-PWPropagateProjectProperties -FolderPath 'PowerShell Demo\Level 2\Level 3\Level 4'
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Update-PWPropagateProjectPropertiesToSubProjects


NAME
    Update-PWPropagateProjectPropertiesToSubProjects
    
SYNOPSIS
    For each rich project passed on the pipeline, update descendents to inherit common Project Property values from projects above. If no rich projects passed, doesn't do anything.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWPropagateProjectPropertiesToSubProjects [[-InputFolders] <ProjectWiseFolder[]>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Note the the cmdlet attempts to use the project properties present at the beginning of the cmdlet. Probably easiest to manage by just passing one folder as this recurses tree by default.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolders <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Target folder object(s) from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Target folder object(s) from pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Get the folder for folder number 20315 and update descendant project properties.
    Get-PWFolders 20315 -JustOne | Update-PWPropagateProjectProperties -Verbose
    #Get the folders in the tree at the given folder path and working down the tree, update descendant project properties
    Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Level 1\Level 2\Level 3' | Update-PWPropagateProjectProperties -Verbose
    #Update document attributes for a given folder
    Get-PWFolders -FolderPath 'Level 1\Level 2\Level 3' -JustOne | Update-PWPropagateProjectProperties -FolderPath 'PowerShell Demo\Level 2\Level 3\Level 4'
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentDestinationDatasource


NAME
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentDestinationDatasource
    
SYNOPSIS
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentDestinationDatasource Updates the datasource associated with the provided output destination folder name with the provided value. All output destination folder settings refering to the datasource are also updated.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentDestinationDatasource [-OutputDestinationFolderName] <string> [-NewDestinationDatasourceName] <string> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentDestinationDatasource Updates the datasource associated with the provided output destination folder name with the provided value. All output destination folder settings refering to the datasource are also updated. These could include the output 
    destination folder and the source distribution folder. To see a list of available output destination folder names, you can issue the cmdlet Get-PWRenditionDestinations. You can also see these with ProjectWise Administrator under Renditions, Rendition Profile Components, Output 
    Destination Folders. If you double-click on one of these, a dialog box will be presented in which you may see a datasource and folder. If these contain datasources, they will be updated with the provided value. If you click on the Source Distribution... button in this dialog box, a 
    dialog will be presented with a destination source folder pattern text item. If that value refers to a datasource, it will be updated with the provided value. An attempt is made to preserve the attribute mapping. This is a major improvement on the Project Administrator 
    functionality. It is assuming that the old destiantion datsource and the updated destination datasource are identical. An attempt is made to deal with fully qualified vs not fully qualified datasource names. The cmdlet returns True if it successfully updates the datasource and all 
    relevant options. False otherwise.
    

PARAMETERS
    -OutputDestinationFolderName <string>
        Output destination folder name. Must exist.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewDestinationDatasourceName <string>
        New destination datasource name. Preferably this is prefixed with the server name followed by a colon.. Must exist.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Updates the datasource in all relevant "Renditions Folder" settings to "NewServer:NewDatasourceName".
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentDestinationDatasource --OutputDestinationFolderName "Renditions Folder" -DatasourceName "WIN-FUGMJORC1LF:simple"
    
    
RELATED LINKS





--

## Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentSourceDistributionFolder


NAME
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentSourceDistributionFolder
    
SYNOPSIS
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentSourceDistributionFolder Updates the source distribution folder path associated with the provided output destination folder name with the provided value.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentSourceDistributionFolder [-OutputDestinationFolderName] <string> [-NewSourceDistributionFolder] <string> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentSourceDistributionFolder Updates the source distribution folder path associated with the provided output destination folder name with the provided value. To see a list of available output destination folder names, you can issue the cmdlet 
    Get-PWRenditionDestinations. You can also see these with ProjectWise Administrator under Renditions, Rendition Profile Components, Output Destination Folders. If you double click on one of these then click on on the Source Distribution... button, a dialog will be presented with a 
    destination source folder pattern text item. That is the value that this cmdlet is updating. Typically the value is a ProjectWise folder path. Returns true if no error occured. False otherwise.
    

PARAMETERS
    -OutputDestinationFolderName <string>
        Output destination folder name. Must exist.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewSourceDistributionFolder <string>
        New source distribution folder ProjectWise Path. Must exist.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Updates the destination option source folder associated with "Renditions Folder" to "pw://WIN-FUGMJORC1LF:simple/Documents/renditions output/".
    Update-PWRenditionProfileComponentSourceDistributionFolder -OutputDestinationFolderName "Renditions Folder" -NewSourceDistributionFolder "pw://WIN-FUGMJORC1LF:simple/Documents/renditions output/"

## Update-PWRichProjectProperties


NAME
    Update-PWRichProjectProperties
    
SYNOPSIS
    Updates the properties of individual rich projects.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWRichProjectProperties [[-InputFolder] <ProjectWiseFolder[]>] [[-FolderPath] <string>] [[-ProjectProperties] <Hashtable>] [[-LookupPropertiesToSet] <string[]>] [[-DisablePicklistPropcessing] <SwitchParameter>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Takes a path or a folder from the pipeline, and a hashtable of project properties.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolder <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Array of folders from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -FolderPath <string>
        Full folder path of rich project to update.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -ProjectProperties <Hashtable>
        Hashtable with project properties.
        
        In script would be like this: @{PROJECT_Project_Name = "My new project"; PROJECT_Project_Number = "00007"; PROJECT_Project_Manager_Email = "joe.blow@bentley.com" }
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -LookupPropertiesToSet <string[]>
        List of properties to set from lookups (often there is an order or implied order to these) (e.g. PROJECT_Project_Number, PROJECT_Project_Country).
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                System.String[]
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DisablePicklistPropcessing <SwitchParameter>
        Disables the filling in of picklist properties. If you are getting unexpected values in these properties, this switch could be beneficial.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Array of folders from pipeline.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Update-PWRichProjectProperties -FolderPath "Test Projects 5\From Script\Project N" -ProjectProperties @{PROJECT_Project_Name='A Project Name'; PROJECT_Project_Number='YYYYY'; PROJECT_Project_Manager_Email='john.smith@acme.com'}
    Get-PWRichProjects -FolderPath 'Top Level\Sub Level' | Update-PWRichProjectProperties -ProjectProperties @{PROJECT_Start_Date = '2017-01-01 01:00:00'; PROJECT_Project_Name='A Project Name'; PROJECT_Project_Number='YYYYY'; PROJECT_Project_Manager_Email='john.smith@acme.com'}
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Update-PWStorageAreaForProjectTree


NAME
    Update-PWStorageAreaForProjectTree
    
SYNOPSIS
    The Update-PWStorageAreaForProjectTree cmdlet updates the storage area of the provided folder path and all of its sub-folders.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWStorageAreaForProjectTree [-FolderPath] <string> [-NewStorageArea] <string> [[-SourceStorageArea] <string>] [-DeleteFromSourceStorage <SwitchParameter>] [-JustOne <SwitchParameter>] [-SkipStorageAreaMatchCheck <SwitchParameter>] [-UseAdminPaths <SwitchParameter>] 
    [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    If the JustOne parameter is included, only the provided folder willbe updated.
    

PARAMETERS
    -FolderPath <string>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewStorageArea <string>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DeleteFromSourceStorage <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -JustOne <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -UseAdminPaths <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SkipStorageAreaMatchCheck <SwitchParameter>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SourceStorageArea <string>
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    The following will update the storage area for the specified folder and all sub-folders.
    
        $Splat_UpdateStorageArea = @{
            FolderPath = "Projects\MyProject"
            NewStorageArea = "NewStorageArea"
            SourceStorageArea = "OldStorageArea"
        }
        Update-PWStorageAreaForProjectTree @Splat_UpdateStorageArea -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    The following will update just the specified folder.
    
        Update-PWStorageAreaForProjectTree @Splat_UpdateStorageArea -JustOne -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 3  ----------
    
    The following will use the admin paths and ONLY update the specified folder.
    
        Update-PWStorageAreaForProjectTree @Splat_UpdateStorageArea -UseAdminPaths -JustOne -Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 4  ----------
    
    The following will use update specified folder and all sub-folders. Deletes the folders from the source storage area.
    
        Update-PWStorageAreaForProjectTree @Splat_UpdateStorageArea -DeleteFromSourceStorage -Verbose
    
    
RELATED LINKS

## Update-PWUserListProperties


NAME
    Update-PWUserListProperties
    
SYNOPSIS
    Updates the provided userlist name and / or description.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWUserListProperties [-InputUserList] <ProjectWiseUserList> [[-NewUserListName] <string>] [[-NewUserListDescription] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Offers a method to update a userlist's name and / or description.
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputUserList <ProjectWiseUserList>
        Array of user objects from the pipeline to add to user list.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewUserListName <string>
        New ProjectWise User name.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewUserListDescription <string>
        New ProjectWise User description.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWWrapper+ProjectWiseUserList
        Array of user objects from the pipeline to add to user list.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    The following will update the userlist name and description for the provided userlist object.
               
               $pwUserListName     = 'PSTest'
               $pwUserListName_New = 'PowerShell_Test'
               $pwUserListDesc_New = 'PowerShell Test UserList'
               
               $pwUserList = Get-PWUserLists -UserListName $pwUserListName
               $Splat_Update = @{
                   InputUserList          = $pwUserList
                   NewUserListName        = $pwUserListName_New
                   NewUserListDescription = $pwUserListDesc_New
               }
               Update - PWUserListProperties @Splat_Update - Verbose
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 2  ----------
    
    The following will update the userlist name for the piped userlist object. 
                Get-PWUserLists -UserListName $pwUserListName | 
                Update-PWUserListProperties -NewUserListName $pwUserListName_New -Verbose
    
    
RELATED LINKS

        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see
