## Update-PWWorkAreaConnection


NAME
    Update-PWWorkAreaConnection
    
SYNOPSIS
    Update existing Project Work Area Connections. Returns true of at least one update was succesful and there were no failures. Otherwise returns false.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWWorkAreaConnection [-InputFolders] <ProjectWiseFolder[]> [-NewWSGURL] <string> [-NewDatasource] <string> [[-WSGVersion] <string>] [[-NewName] <string>] [[-NewPWProjectGuid] <string>] [[-NewDescription] <string>] [-OldWSGURL] <string> [-OldDatasource] <string> [-Token] 
    <string> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    

PARAMETERS
    -InputFolders <ProjectWiseFolder[]>
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewWSGURL <string>
        WSG URL like https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewDatasource <string>
        server:DSN
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -WSGVersion <string>
        WSG Version (default 'v2.5')
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                v2.5
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewName <string>
        Name of connection.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    4
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewPWProjectGuid <string>
        Leave empty to reuse existing Project GUID (would be the post-migration case). Provide a Guid string to do a remapping.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -NewDescription <string>
        Description of connection.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OldWSGURL <string>
        WSG URL like https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws. Work Area Connection URL must match on this and OldDatasource.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    7
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OldDatasource <string>
        server:DSN. Work Area Connection URL must match on this and OldWSGURL.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    8
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByValue)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Token <string>
        Base 64 Encoded Token string from Get-PWNonFederatedLoginToken -CreateWebToken.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    9
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    PWPS_DAB.CommonTypes+ProjectWiseFolder[]
        Array of ProjectWise folders from pipeline.
    
    System.String
        WSG URL like https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws
    
    System.String
        server:DSN
    
    System.String
        WSG Version (default 'v2.5')
    
    System.String
        Name of connection.
    
    System.String
        Leave empty to reuse existing Project GUID (would be the post-migration case). Provide a Guid string to do a remapping.
    
    System.String
        Description of connection.
    
    System.String
        WSG URL like https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws. Work Area Connection URL must match on this and OldDatasource.
    
    System.String
        server:DSN. Work Area Connection URL must match on this and OldWSGURL.
    
    
OUTPUTS
    System.Boolean
    
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    #Redirect Work Area Connections to new datasource and WSG address.
    $token2 = Get-PWConnectionClientToken -UsePWRelyingParty
    $encodedToken = ConvertTo-EncodedToken $token2
    $rps=Get-PWRichProjects -FolderPath 'Projects'
    Update-PWWorkAreaConnection $rps -NewWSGURL 'https://decide-pwce-us-ws.bentley.com/ws' -NewDatasource 'decide-pwce-us.bentley.com:decide-pwce-us-10' -NewName 'US WAC Name' -NewDescription 'US WAC Description' -OldWSGURL 'https://decide-pwce-eu-ws.bentley.com/ws' -OldDatasource 
    'decide-pwce-eu.bentley.com:decide-pwce-eu-10' -Token $encodedToken

## Update-PWWREUsers


NAME
    Update-PWWREUsers
    
SYNOPSIS
    Update-PWWREUsers Updates the Workflow Rules Engine Super User and Rollback User names and passwords.
    
    
SYNTAX
    Update-PWWREUsers [-SUName] <string> [-SUPassword] <SecureString> [-RUName] <string> [-RUPassword] <SecureString> [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Update-PWWREUsers Updates the Workflow Rules Engine Super User and Rollback User names and passwords. These users must already exist in ProjectWise and may not be a member of the Adminstrators or Restricted Administrators grouups. Returns true of all four values are sucessfully set, 
    false otherwise.
    

PARAMETERS
    -SUName <string>
        Workflow Rules Engine Super User Name.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    0
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SUPassword <SecureString>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RUName <string>
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RUPassword <SecureString>
        Workflow Rules Engine Rollback User Password. Must be secure string.
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
    ----------  EXAMPLE 1  ----------
    
    Updates the Workflow Rules Engine Super User and RollBack User Passwords.
    Update-PWWREUsers -SUName "WRESuperUser" -SUPassword SecureString -RUName "WRRollbackUser" -RUPassword SecureString
    
    
RELATED LINKS
